Although set between larger centres of power, Chumnungwa was itself an important place in Mberengwa, connected to both its neighbours and wider regional networks.
simp_chinese: 楚姆农瓜是姆贝伦瓜金矿地区一处以干砌石墙围绕的中心。周围的土地适于耕种和养牛，也蕴藏黄金、铁和皂石。这里属于津巴布韦的石建筑传统，其中心遍布林波波河与赞比西河之间的高原。从14世纪至17世纪，楚姆农瓜与大津巴布韦、卡米及达纳蒙贝等更为人熟知的中心同时兴盛。居民使用本地获取的材料，也使用来自远方的物品。虽然它处在较大权力中心之间，楚姆农瓜本身也是姆贝伦瓜的重要地方，与邻近聚落及更广阔的区域网络相连。

english: Chumphon stands on the Gulf of Siam near the narrow Kra Isthmus. Routes across the peninsula connected it with Kra Buri and the shores facing the Andaman Sea. The town was recorded under the Ayutthaya kings in the fifteenth century and formed part of the network of Siamese settlements along the southern coast. Its position also exposed it to armies crossing the peninsula: Burmese forces attacked and burned Chumphon during the wars of the late eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 春蓬位于暹罗湾沿岸，靠近狭窄的克拉地峡。横贯半岛的道路将它与甲武里及面向安达曼海的海岸连接起来。十五世纪的阿瑜陀耶时期已有关于春蓬的记载，它是暹罗南部沿海城邑网络的一部分。这一位置也使它面临穿越半岛的军队：十八世纪末的战争中，缅甸军队攻陷并焚烧了春蓬。

english: East of Ko Tao, the Gulf of Thailand opens beyond the islands of the Chumphon archipelago. Ko Tao's rocky shores and sandy beaches are bordered by coral reefs, where branching Acropora and massive Porites shelter fish, crustaceans and other marine life. To the north lies the smaller island of Ko Nang Yuan, while farther south the waters lead towards Ko Pha Ngan and Ko Samui.
simp_chinese: 涛岛以东，泰国湾在春蓬群岛之外展开。涛岛的岩岸和沙滩旁生长着珊瑚礁，枝状轴孔珊瑚和块状滨珊瑚为鱼类、甲壳动物及其他海洋生物提供栖身之处。北面是较小的南园岛，往南的水域则通向帕岸岛和苏梅岛。

english: Chumphon Bay lies on the western side of the Gulf of Siam, where the narrow Malay Peninsula separates the gulf from the Andaman Sea. Offshore islands and headlands break up the coast, while rivers descend from the hills to the sea. This narrow part of the peninsula has long offered overland connections between the two coasts, and the bay faces the sailing routes running north through the gulf toward the Chao Phraya plain.
simp_chinese: 春蓬湾位于暹罗湾西侧，狭窄的马来半岛在这里将海湾与安达曼海分开。离岸岛屿与岬角使海岸曲折，河流从内陆丘陵流下，最终汇入大海。这段狭窄的半岛长期提供连接东西两岸的陆上通道；海湾向东敞开，面向沿暹罗湾北上、通往湄南河平原的航路。

english: Chumuch lies in the steep mountain country northeast of Cajamarca, above the basin of the Marañón. The surrounding Celendín highlands were inhabited long before Spanish conquest and maintained ties with communities across the great river. An Inca road linked Cajamarca through Celendín towards Chachapoyas, crossing the difficult country that separates the highland basins from the eastern forests.
simp_chinese: 丘穆奇位于卡哈马卡东北方陡峭山地，俯瞰马拉尼翁河流域。周围塞伦丁高地在西班牙征服之前很久就有人居住，与大河对岸的社群保持联系。一条印加道路从卡哈马卡经塞伦丁通向查查波亚斯，穿越分隔高原盆地与东部森林的险峻地带。

english: Lake Chumyak lies in the wet country near the Demyanka, a winding right-bank tributary of the Irtysh. The river gathers water from the swamps of the West Siberian lowlands and flows west to the Irtysh. The Siberian cartographer Semyon Remezov depicted the Demyanka and its mouth in his maps.
simp_chinese: 丘米亚克湖位于杰米扬卡河附近的湿地。杰米扬卡河是额尔齐斯河右岸的一条曲折支流，汇集西西伯利亚低地沼泽中的水，向西流入额尔齐斯河。西伯利亚地图绘制者谢苗·列梅佐夫曾在地图上绘出这条河及其河口。

english: Chun'an was an old county in the mountains of western Zhejiang, on the upper waters of the Xin'an River. Its seat, known as Hecheng, was home to officials, merchants and families connected by roads and rivers to neighbouring districts. In 1558 the Ming official Hai Rui became magistrate of Chun'an. During his four years in office he sought to reduce abuses, remeasure land and distribute labour obligations more evenly. His strict conduct brought him into conflict with powerful people. A shrine was later erected at Hecheng in his memory.
simp_chinese: 淳安是浙江西部山区的古县，位于新安江上游。县城贺城通过道路和河流与周边地区相连，官员、商人与居民在此聚集。 1558年，明代官员海瑞出任淳安知县。他在四年任内力图革除积弊，重新丈量田地，均派徭役；严正的作风也使他得罪权贵。后来贺城建祠纪念这位知县。

english:
Chunar stands by the Ganges beneath a rocky spur of the Vindhya hills. Its great fort commands the river and has been held by a succession of rulers. Tradition links its foundation to Vikramaditya of Ujjain and his brother Bharthari, who is said to have renounced the world here. The fort's stones and buildings also preserve memories of the Afghan and Mughal rulers who contested this stronghold.

Sher Shah Suri gained possession of Chunar through his marriage to the widow of its governor. In 1537 Humayun marched from Agra and besieged the fort for three months; he later offered Chunar and Jaunpur to Sher Shah in exchange for Bengal. Akbar captured it in 1574, and it remained under Mughal rule until the East India Company took it in 1772. During the rising of Chait Singh of Banaras in 1781, Warren Hastings withdrew to Chunar for safety.
simp_chinese:
楚纳尔位于恒河畔，温迪亚山的一处岩石支脉高踞城镇之上。巨大的堡垒俯瞰河流，历代统治者相继占据这里。传说堡垒由乌贾因的毗迦罗摩阿迭多为兄弟巴尔塔里所建，后者据说在此遁世。堡中的石墙和建筑也留下了阿富汗人与莫卧儿人争夺要塞的记忆。

舍尔沙·苏里通过与堡垒守将的遗孀成婚取得楚纳尔。1537年，胡马雍从阿格拉出发，围攻此堡三个月；后来他提出以楚纳尔和焦恩普尔换取孟加拉。阿克巴于1574年夺取堡垒，此后它一直处于莫卧儿统治之下，直到1772年被东印度公司占领。1781年贝拿勒斯的柴特·辛格起事时，沃伦·黑斯廷斯退到楚纳尔避难。

english: Chundzha lies in the Ili basin near the dry foothills of the Ketmen range. The surrounding plain contains ancient burial grounds, including the Sarytogay necropolis, which preserve traces of the peoples who lived in this country long before the present settlement. To the west the Charyn cuts through the plain, while streams and springs descending from the mountains support vegetation amid the otherwise dry landscape.
simp_chinese: 春贾位于伊犁盆地，靠近凯特门山脉干燥的山麓。周围平原有古代墓地，包括萨雷托盖墓群，保存着比聚落早得多的居民在这片土地上留下的痕迹。西面的恰伦河切穿平原，从山地流下的溪流和泉水则在干旱景观中滋养植被。

english: Ch'ungju lies on the South Han River, at a crossing of routes between Korea's southeast and the capital. In 1592, as Japanese armies advanced north, General Sin Rip was sent to halt them. He drew up his troops with the river behind them at T'an'gŭmdae, near the town. The Korean force was defeated; Sin Rip and his lieutenant Kim Yŏmul fought on before taking their own lives in the river.
simp_chinese: 忠州位于南汉江畔，朝鲜东南部通往都城的道路在此交会。1592年日军北进时，朝廷派将军申砬前往阻击。他在城镇附近的弹琴台背水布阵，朝鲜军最终战败。申砬与部将金汝岉继续奋战，最后投江自尽。

english: Chungu lies in the country north of Lake Bangweulu, where woodland and shallow valleys lead towards the great lake basin. The BenaMukulu of Chungu are among the communities of the Bangweulu region, sharing the Bemba language with neighbouring peoples. To the south, the lake merges with lagoons, reed beds and a broad floodplain. Its waters rise and fall with the seasons, changing the extent of the marshes around its shores.
simp_chinese: 琼古位于班韦乌卢湖北面的地区，林地与浅谷向南延伸至广阔的湖盆。当地的贝纳穆库卢人是班韦乌卢地区的社群之一，与邻近各族同说本巴语。南方的湖水与潟湖、芦苇丛和宽阔的洪泛平原连成一片；水位随季节升降，湖岸沼泽的范围也随之变化。

english: Chunhua lies among the uplands north of the Wei River plain. The district was once part of Yunyang, a place of imperial palaces in Qin and Han times. North of the later county town stood Ganquan Palace, visited by Han emperors for ceremonies and celebrated in a prose poem by Yang Xiong. In 993 the Song made Liyuan a county seat and named the new county Chunhua after the reigning emperor's era. A Qing gazetteer carefully distinguished this Liyuan from the famous Tang court music school of the same name.
simp_chinese: 淳化位于渭河平原以北的高地，古时属于云阳一带，秦汉时期曾有帝王宫苑。后来的县城以北有甘泉宫，汉代皇帝曾到此举行祭祀，扬雄也为宫殿作赋。993年，宋朝以梨园镇置县，取当时年号命名淳化。清代县志特意辨明，此地梨园与唐朝宫廷教坊的同名梨园并非一处。

english: Ch'unju, later known as Ch'unch'ŏn, lies among the river valleys and mountains of central Korea. Under Koryŏ it gave its name to a network of relay stations that connected the town with neighbouring districts and the road toward the capital. The name Ch'unju dated from 940; in 1413, the Joseon government renamed the town Ch'unch'ŏn during a wider reorganisation of local administration.
simp_chinese: 春州后来称为春川，坐落在朝鲜中部的河谷与山地之间。高丽时期，以春州命名的驿路网络连接邻近地区和通往都城的道路。春州之名始于940年；1413年，朝鲜政府整顿地方行政时将其改称春川。

english: The southern Peruvian Andes rise above the high plains west of Lake Titicaca, with cold grasslands giving way to rocky ridges and summits. Streams from the mountains cross the puna and flow towards inland basins. The region lies between the volcanic ranges of Arequipa and the high plateau of the southern Andes. Its altitude and sparse vegetation give the landscape a stark appearance above the more sheltered valleys.
simp_chinese: 秘鲁南部安第斯群山耸立在的的喀喀湖以西的高原上，寒冷草地向上过渡为岩石山脊和峰峦。山间溪流穿过普纳高地，流向内陆盆地。这片地区位于阿雷基帕火山山脉与南安第斯高原之间，海拔高、植被稀疏，在较为避风的河谷上方呈现出荒峻景象。

english:
Chunoyar is placed in the Siberian forest country associated with the wider Bratsk region. Taiga, rivers and long winters form the setting for travel and hunting in the Angara basin.

Russian expeditions reached the Bratsk area in the 1620s to collect tribute from Buryat communities. In 1631 an outpost was established at the junction of the Oka and Angara rivers. It became a base for Russian activity in the region, and its wooden fortifications survived in part.
simp_chinese:
丘诺亚尔位于与布拉茨克相关的西伯利亚森林地区。泰加林、河流和漫长冬季构成安加拉河流域行旅与狩猎的环境。

1620年代，俄国远征队抵达布拉茨克一带，向布里亚特社群征收贡赋。1631年，奥卡河与安加拉河汇合处建立哨堡，成为俄国在当地活动的据点；其木制防御建筑有部分留存。

english:
Hunza was the seat of the zaque, the northern ruler of the Muisca, on a cold plateau of the Eastern Cordillera. Tradition says the Muisca chose Hunzahúa of Ramiriquí as supreme lord, and the title zaque (“great lord”) passed down in Hunza, matched by the zipa at Bacatá. Around 1490 the zipa Saguanmachica marched on the zaque Michua with 50,000 men and the two lords died in the same battle at Chocontá. The last zaque, Quemuenchatocha, held court in a fenced compound with gold and emeralds.

On 20 August 1537 Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada rode in with horses and dogs and seized his gold, emeralds and cloth. Quesada's brother Hernán Pérez de Quesada took Quemuenchatocha's successor Quiminza prisoner on a rumour of revolt, and had him beheaded in 1540, ending the line of the Hunza rulers. On 6 August 1539 Gonzalo Suárez Rendón had founded Tunja on the zaque's own enclosure, where the Augustinian convent later rose. Franciscans arrived in 1550, Dominicans a year later and Jesuits by 1611. Tunja became a “mother city” of the colony's Andean east, rich in churches and poets. In 1781 the Comuneros revolt over taxes reached it, and in 1811 Tunja proclaimed itself a republic.
simp_chinese:
洪萨是穆伊斯卡人北部统治者萨克的驻地，位于东科迪勒拉山脉一处寒冷的高原上。传说穆伊斯卡人推举拉米里基的洪萨乌阿为最高首领，“萨克”（意为大君）这个头衔在洪萨世代相传，与巴卡塔的西帕相对。约1490年，西帕萨瓜马奇卡率五万人进攻萨克米丘亚，两位首领在乔孔塔的同一场战斗中阵亡。末代萨克凯穆恩查托查住在一处围场内，金饰与祖母绿俱全。

1537年8月20日，贡萨洛·希门尼斯·德·克萨达带着马和狗冲进来，抢走了他的金子、祖母绿和织物。克萨达之弟埃尔南·佩雷斯·德·克萨达因听说有叛乱谣言，抓住凯穆恩查托查的继承人基明萨，于1540年将其斩首，洪萨统治者世系就此终结。1539年8月6日，贡萨洛·苏亚雷斯·伦东在萨克的围场旧址上建起通哈，后来奥斯定会修道院建在那里。方济各会1550年到来，多明我会次年到，耶稣会1611年前到。通哈成为殖民地安第斯东部的“母城”，教堂和诗人荟萃。1781年因税收引发的公社起义波及这里，1811年通哈宣布成立共和国。

english: Chupanga stands on the southern bank of the lower Zambezi, where wooded country borders the great river and its floodplain. It became part of the network of prazos, estates granted under Portuguese authority along the valley. In 1783 the land of Chupanga was granted to Manuel Ribeiro dos Santos. Like other estates on the Zambezi, it belonged to a region where African communities and holders of Portuguese grants shaped local power and access to the river.
simp_chinese: 楚潘加位于赞比西河下游南岸，林地毗邻大河及其洪泛平原。这里后来成为河谷中普拉佐庄园网络的一部分，这些庄园由葡萄牙当局授予。1783年，楚潘加的土地被授予曼努埃尔·里贝罗·多斯桑托斯。与赞比西河其他庄园一样，这里处在非洲社群和葡萄牙土地受让者共同影响地方权力与河流通行的地区。

english: Chupilta lies in the dry plains east of the Salado River in Santiago del Estero. The surrounding country formed part of the frontier between colonial settlements and the peoples of the Chaco. Abipón communities inhabited the wider region, and the names of Chupilta, Lascomba and Vitiaca became associated with this open frontier. Woodland, seasonal streams and plains shaped travel through the country beyond the river.
simp_chinese: 丘皮尔塔位于圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗萨拉多河以东的干燥平原。周围地区曾是殖民聚落与查科诸民族之间的边疆。阿比蓬社群居住于更广阔的地区，丘皮尔塔、拉斯孔巴与维蒂亚卡的名称都与这片开放边疆有关。河外的林地、季节性溪流和平原影响着穿越当地的道路。

english:
Chǔqiū was a county of the Cáo country on the flat Yellow River plain of southwestern Shandong, close to the Henan border. The name is old: under the Tang the county belonged to Songzhou, and under the Song to Yingtian Prefecture, and Li Changling, who rose to deputy chief minister under Emperor Taizong of Song, came from here.

In 1344 the Yellow River burst its dikes at Baimao and flooded the lands around Cao, Pu and Jining, one of the disasters that fed the Red Turban risings. Guo Zixing, whose family came from Caozhou, raised rebels at Haozhou in 1352; his adopted son-in-law was Zhu Yuanzhang, the future Ming founder. In 1371 the Ming reduced Caozhou to Cao County, and in 1445 the department was restored at its old seat of Chengshi, with Cao County once more under it. Caozhou had been known since Sui and Tang times for its peonies, and in 1735 the Qing raised it to a prefecture seated at Heze.
simp_chinese:
楚丘是古曹地的一个县，坐落在黄河冲积平原上的鲁西南，靠近河南边界，田野平坦，水患频仍。县名由来已久：唐代属宋州，宋代属应天府，北宋的李昌龄就出生在这里，曾在宋太宗朝官至参知政事。

1344年，黄河在白茅决堤，洪水淹及曹州、濮州和济宁一带，成为催生元末红巾起义的灾祸之一。祖籍曹州的郭子兴于1352年在濠州起兵，他的养女婿朱元璋后来建立了明朝。1371年，明朝把曹州降为曹县；1445年，又在旧治乘氏重设曹州，曹县重归其下。曹州自隋唐以来便以牡丹闻名，1735年清朝将其升为曹州府，府治设在菏泽。

sources.title: 山東等處承宣布政使司

english:
Chuqiyapu lies in a deep valley below the Bolivian altiplano, where the city of La Paz grew amid steep slopes and mountain streams. The valley was inhabited before the Spanish arrival, and its position linked the high plateau with the eastern valleys. La Paz became a meeting place on the routes between the silver country of Upper Peru and the markets farther north.

The Spanish founded Nuestra Señora de La Paz in 1548, first at Laja before moving the settlement to the Chuqiyapu valley. Merchants, churches and colonial officials established themselves among Indigenous communities whose labour sustained the growing town. In 1781 an Aymara uprising led by Túpac Katari besieged La Paz twice, cutting it off for months. The city endured severe shortages before royalist forces relieved it, and the rebellion was ultimately crushed. The siege showed how closely the valley depended on the surrounding countryside for food and supplies, and how powerful the resistance to colonial authority had become in the highlands.

On 16 July 1809 Pedro Domingo Murillo and other local leaders challenged Spanish authority and formed a governing junta. The movement was suppressed, but it became an important episode in the longer struggle for independence. The city remained closely tied to the altiplano and its peoples, whose resistance had already shaken colonial rule a generation earlier.
simp_chinese:
丘基雅普位于玻利维亚高原之下的深谷，拉巴斯城在陡坡与山间溪流之间发展起来。西班牙人到来之前，河谷已有居民；这里连接高原与东部河谷。拉巴斯成为上秘鲁银矿地区与北方市场之间道路的交会点。

1548年，西班牙人首先在拉哈建立和平圣母城，随后将聚落迁至丘基雅普河谷。商人、教会和殖民官员在原住民社群之间立足，居民的劳动支撑着不断扩张的城镇。1781年，图帕克·卡塔里领导的艾马拉起义军两次围困拉巴斯，使城市数月与外界隔绝。城内遭遇严重匮乏，直到保皇军解围，起义最终遭到镇压。围城表明，河谷的食物和补给深深依赖周边乡村，也显示高地对殖民权威的抵抗已经十分强大。

1809年7月16日，佩德罗·多明戈·穆里略等地方领袖挑战西班牙权威，组成政府委员会。运动虽被镇压，却成为漫长独立斗争的重要一幕。城市仍与高原及其人民紧密相连，而这些人民的抵抗早在一代人之前便已动摇殖民统治。

english: Castrovirreyna lies high in the Andes of central Peru, amid cold mountain valleys and silver-bearing rock. Its mining district was discovered in 1591, and a settlement grew around the work of extracting and processing ore. The town took its name from the wife of Viceroy García Hurtado de Mendoza. Like other Andean mining centers, its fortunes depended on labor and supplies brought across difficult mountain routes to the high workings.
simp_chinese: 卡斯特罗维雷纳位于秘鲁中部安第斯高处，周围是寒冷山谷和含银岩层。1591年，当地矿区被发现，聚落随着采矿和矿石加工而发展。城镇以总督加西亚·乌尔塔多·德·门多萨夫人的名字命名。与其他安第斯矿业中心一样，它的兴衰依赖劳力与物资沿艰难山路运抵高处矿场。

english:
Chur lies in the Alpine Rhine valley where routes over several mountain passes converge. The Roman settlement of Curia Raetorum became the capital of Raetia Prima under Diocletian, and Chur later became the seat of a powerful bishop. In 952 Emperor Otto I granted the town the right to collect tolls; its bishops controlled the road towards Chiavenna, across the Alps.

In 1367 communities formed the League of the House of God at Chur to resist the growing power of the bishop and the Habsburgs. After a great fire in 1464, the emperor confirmed the town's rights, and its citizens adopted a constitution placing government in the hands of the guilds. The league joined two others to form the Three Leagues. From 1523 Johannes Comander preached the Reformation in Chur; by 1527 the town, apart from the bishop's estates, had adopted it. In 1803 the Three Leagues became the Swiss canton of Graubünden, with Chur as its capital.
simp_chinese:
库尔位于阿尔卑斯山区的莱茵河谷，多条穿越山口的道路在此汇合。戴克里先统治时期，罗马聚落库里亚·雷托鲁姆成为雷蒂亚第一行省的首府，后来库尔又成为权势显赫的主教驻地。九五二年，皇帝奥托一世授予城镇征收通行税的权利；主教控制着越过阿尔卑斯、通向基亚文纳的道路。

一三六七年，各社群在库尔成立神所同盟，以抵抗主教和哈布斯堡家族不断增长的权力。一四六四年大火后，皇帝确认城镇权利，市民制定宪章，将政府交由行会掌握。神所同盟与另外两个同盟组成三同盟。一五二三年起，约翰内斯·科曼德在库尔宣讲宗教改革；到一五二七年，除主教领地外，城镇已接受新教。一八〇三年，三同盟成为瑞士的格劳宾登州，库尔成为首府。

english: Churajón is an extensive archaeological complex southeast of Arequipa, among the dry western slopes of the Andes. Settlements, agricultural terraces and water channels reveal how its inhabitants cultivated a difficult landscape. Pottery found across the complex reflects contacts among several southern Andean traditions, as well as later Inca and colonial occupation. Its terraces and clustered buildings preserve the history of communities that made use of mountain water in an arid region.
simp_chinese: 丘拉洪是阿雷基帕东南方一处广阔的考古建筑群，位于安第斯干燥西坡。聚落、梯田和水渠显示居民如何耕作艰难的地形。建筑群各处发现的陶器反映了南安第斯多种传统之间的联系，以及后来的印加与殖民时期占用。梯田和成群建筑保存着在干旱地区利用山水的社区历史。

english: Çurapçii, known as Churapcha, lies beside its namesake lake in the Sakha Republic, about 178 kilometres east of Yakutsk. The lake drains into the Tatta River, a tributary of the Aldan and part of the wider Lena basin. The village was founded in 1725 after a road from Yakutsk toward Okhotsk was opened for post and trade. The route crossed rough, isolated country and was never fully operational. Forest, water and the difficult road joined this settlement to a much wider northern landscape.
simp_chinese: 丘拉普恰又称 Çurapçii，位于萨哈共和国同名湖泊旁，距雅库茨克以东约178公里。湖水流向塔塔河，后者是阿尔丹河的支流，属于更广阔的勒拿河流域。1725年，雅库茨克通往鄂霍次克的道路开通后，村落随之建立，承担邮递和贸易联系。道路穿越崎岖而偏远的地区，始终未能充分运作。森林、湖水与这条艰难的道路把聚落连入辽阔的北方地域。

english:
Churchill Lake spreads across the glacial country of northwestern Saskatchewan as one of the broad waters at the head of the Churchill River system. Frobisher Lake enters through Simonds Channel, Peter Pond Lake through Kisis Channel, and the southern MacBeth Channel leads toward Lac Île-à-la-Crosse. From this linked basin the Churchill River runs more than 1,600 kilometres eastward to Hudson Bay.

The lake was already part of an Indigenous canoe network when European traders entered the interior. Cree people called the Churchill River Missinipi, or “big waters,” and moved along its lakes for fish, fur-bearing animals and seasonal camps. Ice could close the surface from November into May, making open-water travel a narrow seasonal opportunity.

French traders reached the Saskatchewan country in the first half of the eighteenth century. By the 1770s, Montréal traders were following routes north from the Saskatchewan River into the Churchill system, and Peter Pond crossed Methye Portage in 1778. Franklin's map of 1819–1822 still called the lake Clear Lake and left its northern reaches uncertain, showing how recently the route had been fitted to European charts.

The lake linked the forested north with the fur posts and portages beyond it. Fish and water travel supported small parties and families, while rival companies depended on guides who knew the channels and winter ice.
simp_chinese:
丘吉尔湖位于萨斯喀彻温西北部冰川地貌中，是丘吉尔河水系源头的宽阔湖面之一。弗罗比舍湖经西蒙兹水道注入，彼得庞德湖经基西斯水道流入，南端的麦克白水道则把湖水引向克罗斯湖。丘吉尔河从这片相连的水域向东流经一千六百多公里，最终进入哈得孙湾。

欧洲商人进入内地以前，湖泊已经属于原住民独木舟网络。克里人把丘吉尔河称为Missinipi，即“大水”，沿湖寻找鱼类、毛皮兽和季节营地。湖面可能从十一月封冻至五月，适合水上往来的时期很短。

十八世纪上半叶，法国商人进入萨斯喀彻温地区。到一七七〇年代，蒙特利尔商人已从萨斯喀彻温河向北进入丘吉尔水系，彼得·庞德更在一七七八年越过梅西陆运道。富兰克林一八一九至一八二二年的地图仍把湖泊标作清水湖，北端范围也不确定，说明欧洲海图仍在追赶既有路线。

这座湖连接森林北方与远方的毛皮商站、陆运道。鱼类和水路支持小型队伍与家庭，竞争中的商号则依赖熟悉水道和冬季冰况的向导。

english: The Churchill River upland near Waskaiowaka Lake is a forested country of lakes, streams and portages. The Little Churchill River leaves Waskaiowaka and flows northeast to the Churchill. In 1807 Peter Fidler noted a canoe route from the Little Churchill towards the Nelson River, across the country around Split and Assean lakes.
simp_chinese: 丘吉尔河高地靠近瓦斯凯奥瓦卡湖，森林中分布着湖泊、溪流和陆上搬运路线。小丘吉尔河从瓦斯凯奥瓦卡湖流出，向东北汇入丘吉尔河。1807 年，彼得·菲德勒记下了一条从小丘吉尔河通往纳尔逊河的独木舟路线，穿过斯普利特湖与阿西恩湖周围的地区。

english:
Off the mouth of the Churchill River, shallow water extends into the southwestern reaches of Hudson Bay. Beluga whales gather in the river's estuary during the summer, their white backs visible in the channels near the shore. The river also brought people from the interior to the bay, where Cree, Dene and Inuit hunters traded with the Hudson's Bay Company.

In 1717 James Knight established a company post on the river. The company later began a stone fort nearer the coast, known as Prince of Wales Fort, to protect its trade. French ships under La Pérouse captured the fort in 1782; the following year the company rebuilt its post farther up the river. Ships bound for Churchill had to find their way through the shallow coastal waters before reaching the river mouth.
simp_chinese:
丘吉尔河口外，浅水向哈得孙湾西南部延伸。夏季，白鲸聚集在河口，近岸水道中可见它们洁白的背脊。这条河也将内陆的人们带到海湾，克里、德内和因纽特猎人在此与哈得孙湾公司交易。

1717年，詹姆斯·奈特在河边设立公司商站。为了保护贸易，公司后来在更靠近海岸的地方兴建石堡，即威尔士亲王堡。1782年，拉佩鲁兹率领的法国舰队攻占了堡垒；次年，公司在河流上游重建商站。驶向丘吉尔的船只须穿过沿岸浅水，才能抵达河口。

english:
Churkampa, called Churcampa, lies in the highlands of Huancavelica between cold puna and deeply cut valleys. Rivers descend toward the Mantaro and Apurímac basins, while terraces and pastures occupy different elevations. Frost and irregular rain make farming dependent on stored water, camelids and carefully chosen fields.

Quechua communities organized local agriculture through ayllus and village authorities. Potatoes, quinoa and maize were combined with herding of llamas and alpacas. Roads connected high pastures to valley markets and to the silver districts of Huancavelica, drawing local labor and produce into the colonial mining economy.

Spanish administration consolidated villages and extracted tribute and labor from Quechua households. Despite mission churches and colonial offices, Quechua remained the first language of most residents. Churkampa's early identity combines highland ecology, ayllu landholding and the difficult relationship between villages and distant mining centres. Colonial roads linked villages to mercury mines in Huancavelica, drawing food, textiles and labor from surrounding highlands.Local textile and pottery production reached mining settlements through the same roads that brought mercury and imported goods back.
simp_chinese:
丘尔坎帕位于万卡韦利卡高地，在寒冷普纳与深切谷地之间。河流向曼塔罗和阿普里马克流域下降，梯田和牧场分布在不同海拔。霜冻与不规律降雨使农业依赖蓄水、骆驼科牲畜和谨慎选择田地。

克丘亚社群通过艾柳和村社权威组织农业。马铃薯、藜麦和玉米同羊驼、骆马放牧结合。道路把高牧场同谷地市场及万卡韦利卡银矿区相连，使地方劳力和物产进入殖民矿业经济。

西班牙行政把村庄集中，并向克丘亚家庭征收贡赋和劳役。尽管出现传教教堂与殖民官署，克丘亚语仍是多数居民的第一语言。丘尔坎帕的早期身份结合高地生态、艾柳土地制度以及村庄同远方矿业中心之间的紧张关系。殖民道路把村庄同万卡韦利卡水银矿相连，从周边高地抽取粮食、织物和劳力。地方织物和陶器经同一条道路进入矿区，水银与进口货物则运回高地。

english: Churu lies amid the sandy plains of northern Rajasthan, on the eastern edge of the Thar Desert. The town was held by a local chief under the rulers of Bikaner and grew around a fort. Merchants built houses with painted walls and courtyards, while wells and tanks supplied water in a dry landscape. Its position connected the desert country with markets farther east, making it a meeting place for traders and pastoral communities.
simp_chinese: 楚鲁位于拉贾斯坦北部的沙质平原、塔尔沙漠东缘。地方首领在比卡内尔统治者之下掌有城镇，聚落围绕堡垒发展。商人修建带有彩绘墙壁和庭院的宅邸，水井和蓄水池则为干旱地区供水。这里的位置将沙漠地区与更东面的市场相连，使商人和牧民在此相遇。

english: Churumekua, later known as Churumuco, lies in the hot Balsas country of southern Michoacán. Its name is interpreted as “bird’s beak”. Local history records its incorporation into the Purépecha realm through the campaigns of the lord of La Huacana. In 1798 José María Morelos served as priest at Churumuco and La Huacana before taking charge of the parish of Carácuaro, from which he joined the independence struggle in 1810.
simp_chinese: 丘鲁梅夸后来称为丘鲁穆科，位于米却肯南部炎热的巴尔萨斯河地区。其名称被解释为“鸟喙”。地方历史记载，拉瓦卡纳的领主通过征战将这里纳入普雷佩查人的领土。1798年，何塞·玛丽亚·莫雷洛斯在丘鲁穆科和拉瓦卡纳担任神父，随后接管卡拉夸罗教区，并于1810年从那里加入独立斗争。

english:
Chuuk is a group of high volcanic islands within a great lagoon in the Caroline Islands. A surrounding barrier reef shelters the islands and their communities, whose villages were organized around lineages and local chiefs. Canoes linked the islands across the lagoon and connected Chuuk with outlying atolls. The reefs enclosed low coral islets as well as the volcanic peaks rising within the lagoon.

In 1565 Alonso de Arellano entered the lagoon in the San Lucas and anchored off Toloas. His crew traded with islanders before hostile canoes drove the ship away. In 1824 Louis Duperrey’s Coquille approached the high islands; canoes came out to trade for iron, and the French expedition charted the northern and eastern reef without entering the lagoon.
simp_chinese:
楚克是加罗林群岛中一组位于大潟湖内的高耸火山岛。外围堡礁庇护着岛屿与其社群；村落围绕宗族和地方首领组织。独木舟连接潟湖中的各岛，也把楚克与外侧环礁联系起来。礁盘不仅围住潟湖内的火山高峰，也围住低矮的珊瑚小岛。

1565年，阿隆索·德·阿雷利亚诺驾驶圣卢卡斯号进入潟湖，在托洛阿斯外海下锚。船员与岛民交易，随后被敌对独木舟逐走。1824年，路易·迪佩雷的贝壳号驶近高岛；岛民划舟前来换取铁器，法国探险队在未进入潟湖的情况下测绘了北部和东部礁缘。

english: Chuuk’s high islands rise within a vast lagoon enclosed by a coral barrier reef. Island communities had long inhabited the lagoon when Manuel Dublon brought his ship into it in 1814. In 1824 Louis Duperrey’s expedition sailed around the reef and charted the islands.
simp_chinese: 楚克高岛从一片巨大潟湖中升起，外围是珊瑚堡礁。1814年曼努埃尔·杜布隆驾船进入潟湖时，岛屿社群已在这里生活很久。1824年，路易·迪佩雷的船队环绕礁体航行，绘制岛屿海图。

english: South of Chuuk, the open Pacific Ocean extends beyond the lagoon’s enclosing coral reef. Chuukese communities inhabited the islands within the lagoon long before European contact. In 1824 Louis Duperrey’s expedition sailed around the barrier reef and charted the island group.
simp_chinese: 楚克以南的开阔太平洋延伸至围住潟湖的珊瑚礁之外。与欧洲人接触之前，楚克社群早已在潟湖中的岛屿生活。1824年，路易·迪佩雷的船队环绕堡礁航行，绘制岛群海图。

english: South of Chuuk, the open Pacific Ocean extends beyond a vast lagoon enclosed by coral reef. Chuukese communities lived on its high islands before European contact. In 1824 Louis Duperrey’s expedition sailed around the barrier reef and charted the island group.
simp_chinese: 楚克以南，太平洋延伸至珊瑚礁围绕的巨大潟湖之外。与欧洲人接触之前，楚克社群已在潟湖中的高岛生活。1824年，路易·迪佩雷的船队环绕堡礁航行，绘制岛群海图。

english: Southwest of Chuuk, the open waters of the Pacific surround the scattered Caroline Islands. Chuuk’s high islands rise within a large lagoon enclosed by reef. In 1824 Louis Duperrey’s expedition sailed around the reef, recording the islands and their position during its Pacific voyage.
simp_chinese: 楚克西南方的开阔水域环绕零散的加罗林群岛。楚克高岛从礁体围成的大潟湖中升起。1824年，路易·迪佩雷的船队环绕礁体航行，在太平洋航行中记录了岛屿及其位置。

english: Northwest of Chuuk, the open waters of the Pacific lie beyond the atolls of the Caroline Islands. Island communities maintained links with Yap through sawei voyages and exchanges. Yapese pottery found on eastern islands indicates that these connections reached back several centuries.
simp_chinese: 楚克西北方的开阔太平洋水域位于加罗林群岛环礁之外。岛屿社群通过萨韦航行和交换与雅浦维持联系。东部岛屿发现的雅浦陶器表明，这些联系可追溯数百年。

english: North of Chuuk, the open Pacific Ocean separates the lagoon’s high islands from low coral atolls. Island communities maintained connections through canoe voyages before European contact. In 1824 Louis Duperrey’s expedition sailed around Chuuk’s barrier reef and recorded its lagoon islands.
simp_chinese: 楚克以北，太平洋将潟湖高岛与低矮珊瑚环礁隔开。与欧洲人接触之前，岛屿社群已通过独木舟航行维持联系。1824年，路易·迪佩雷的船队环绕楚克堡礁航行，记录了其中的岛屿。

english: Chuuk Lagoon is enclosed by a broad barrier reef, within which volcanic islands rise above the water. Island communities lived in villages organized around lineages and local chiefs. In 1565 Alonso de Arellano anchored off Toloas in the San Lucas and traded with islanders before hostile canoes forced the ship to leave.
simp_chinese: 楚克潟湖由宽广堡礁包围，火山岛屿在礁内水面上拔起。岛民居住在围绕宗族和地方首领组织的村落中。1565年，阿隆索·德·阿雷利亚诺乘圣卢卡斯号在托洛阿斯外海下锚，与岛民交易，随后被敌对独木舟迫使离开。

english: Chuva lies near the Chuna, a river of the Angara basin. Known as the Uda farther upstream, the Chuna flows west through the forests of central Siberia. It joins the Biryusa to form the Taseyeva, which carries their waters to the Angara.
simp_chinese: 丘瓦位于丘纳河附近，属于安加拉河流域。丘纳河上游称作乌达河，穿过西伯利亚中部森林向西流，与比留萨河汇合形成塔谢耶瓦河，河水再流入安加拉河。

english: The western Chuvan country lies among the uplands and river valleys south of Chaun Bay. Rivers flow north across tundra toward the Arctic coast, while the Anadyr basin lies beyond the southern watershed. Chuvan communities shared the wider northeastern interior with Chukchi and other peoples; reindeer herding and hunting linked their movements to seasonal pastures and the animals of the tundra.
simp_chinese: 楚万地区西部位于恰翁湾以南的高地和河谷之间。河流向北穿过苔原，流向北极海岸，南方分水岭另一侧则是阿纳德尔流域。楚万社群与楚科奇及其他民族共同生活在广阔的东北内陆；驯鹿放牧和狩猎使他们的迁徙与季节性牧场和苔原动物紧密相连。

english: The eastern Chuvan uplands surround the headwaters of rivers flowing toward the Anadyr. Tundra covers the valleys between bare ridges, and Lake El'gygytgyn lies in a great circular basin in the high country. Chuvan reindeer herders moved through the wider Anadyr region, sharing the interior with neighbouring peoples. Snow and ice dominate the long winter, while the short summer opens the high pastures.
simp_chinese: 楚万东部高地环绕流向阿纳德尔河的诸河源头。苔原覆盖裸露山脊之间的河谷，埃尔吉吉特金湖坐落在高地上一座巨大的圆形盆地中。楚万驯鹿牧民在更广阔的阿纳德尔地区迁徙，与邻近民族共同生活在内陆。漫长冬季冰雪主宰大地，短暂夏季则开放高地牧场。

english:
This stretch of Chuvan country faces outward from the upper Anadyr toward the long distances of Chukotka. Rivers descend from low mountains through tundra and open forest, and seasonal fish runs provide the most dependable gatherings of food. Movement was tied to ice, snowmelt and the migration of reindeer.

In the seventeenth century Chuvan groups travelled along upper tributaries of the Anadyr and Anyuy. They spoke a Yukaghir-related language and combined fishing, hunting and reindeer herding. The region lay between expanding Russian tribute collectors, Chukchi raiders and neighboring Koryak communities, so alliances and migration routes carried political as well as economic weight.

During the following century, attacks pushed some Chuvan families toward the Kolyma, where they increasingly adopted Russian ways, while others joined Koryak or Chukchi communities. The southern upper Anadyr remained a remembered homeland even as communities dispersed. Its identity rests on movement across a cold watershed rather than on one permanent town. The upper Anadyr remained remote from Russian administrative centres. River crossings, reindeer pastures and winter trails continued to shape movement among families who retained a separate Chuvan identity. Tribute collectors and trading parties passed through the same valleys. Seasonal camps moved with fish, game and reindeer. For many generations.
simp_chinese:
楚万地区的这一段从阿纳德尔河上游伸向楚科奇广袤内陆。河流从低山穿过苔原和疏林，季节性鱼群提供最可靠的粮食聚集。居民往来受冰情、融雪和驯鹿迁徙支配。

十七世纪，楚万群体沿阿纳德尔河与阿纽伊河上游支流活动。他们使用与尤卡吉尔语有关的语言，兼营捕鱼、狩猎和驯鹿放牧。这里夹在扩张中的俄国贡赋征收者、楚科奇袭击者与邻近科里亚克社群之间，联盟和迁徙路线因此兼有政治与经济意义。

下一世纪，冲突迫使部分楚万家庭迁向科雷马河，并逐渐接受俄罗斯文化；另一些人则加入科里亚克或楚科奇社群。即使社群分散，南部的阿纳德尔上游仍是记忆中的故土。其身份来自寒冷分水岭上的迁徙，而不依赖单一永久城镇。阿纳德尔上游远离俄国行政中心。渡口、驯鹿牧场和冬季道路继续组织仍保持楚万身份的家庭往来。贡赋征收者和贸易队伍也穿越相同谷地，季节营地随鱼类、猎物和驯鹿迁移。 延续许多代。

english: The Chuvan uplands rise around Lake El'gygytgyn, whose circular basin is enclosed by a raised rim of hills. The lake fills an ancient impact crater, and the Enmyvaam escapes through the southeastern edge toward the Anadyr basin. Bare ridges and tundra valleys surround the water, which remains ice-covered for most of the year in this remote Arctic landscape.
simp_chinese: 楚万高地环绕埃尔吉吉特金湖，湖泊的圆形盆地外缘是隆起的丘陵。湖水填满一座古老撞击坑，恩米瓦姆河从东南侧流出，通向阿纳德尔流域。裸露山脊和苔原河谷围绕湖水，这片偏远北极地区的湖面一年中大部分时间被冰覆盖。

english: East of Lake El'gygytgyn, the Chuvan highlands give way to the valleys feeding the Anadyr River. The river gathers streams from the mountainous interior before reaching the broad lowlands that open toward the Bering Sea. Tundra and bare ridges surround its headwaters, and long winters freeze the streams. Summer snowmelt and rain swell them on their course through the uplands.
simp_chinese: 埃尔吉吉特金湖以东，楚万高地逐渐过渡为滋养阿纳德尔河的河谷。大河汇集山地内陆的溪流，然后进入通向白令海的广阔低地。苔原和裸露山脊环绕河源，漫长冬季使溪流封冻；夏季融雪与降雨则使穿过高地的水流上涨。

english: Chuwalee is an Indigenous name for the Elk River, a tributary of the Tennessee. Rising in the uplands of the Cumberland Plateau, the river winds westward through the southern Tennessee country before turning south and joining the greater river in northern Alabama. Along its course, gravel bars and rocky beds break the current into shallows and deeper pools. The Elk is one of many streams that carry the waters of the interior toward the Tennessee and, ultimately, the Ohio.
simp_chinese: 楚瓦利是埃尔克河的一个原住民名称。这条田纳西河的支流发源于坎伯兰高原，向西蜿蜒流过田纳西南部，继而折向南方，在阿拉巴马北部汇入大河。河道中的砾石滩与岩石河床将水流分成浅滩和深潭。埃尔克河与众多溪流一道，将内陆的水带入田纳西河，最终流向俄亥俄河。

english: The Chuwi were among the peoples of the southern Andean highlands and valleys, neighbours of the Charka and Qhara Qhara. Their leaders belonged to a political landscape shaped by alliances between local peoples and the expanding Inca state. Later colonial records name the Chuwi among the groups whose authorities presented their history and claims to the Spanish Crown in the Memorial de Charcas.
simp_chinese: 丘维人是南安第斯高地和河谷的族群之一，与查尔卡人及卡拉卡拉人为邻。他们的领袖处在地方各族与扩张中的印加国家结成联盟的政治格局之中。后来的殖民文献将丘维人列为《查尔卡斯呈文》中向西班牙王室陈述历史和权利主张的族群之一。

english: The Chuy stream crosses the low coastal country between the Atlantic and the great lagoons of southern Brazil and eastern Uruguay. In the eighteenth century this was a disputed frontier between Portugal and Spain. The Portuguese built Fort San Miguel in 1737 and began the fortress of Santa Teresa in 1762. After the Treaty of San Ildefonso in 1777, Spanish and Portuguese commissioners met at the Chuy to begin marking their boundary.
simp_chinese: 舒伊溪穿过大西洋与巴西南部、乌拉圭东部大潟湖之间的低平沿海地区。十八世纪，这里是葡萄牙与西班牙争夺的边境。葡萄牙人于1737年修建圣米格尔堡，1762年开始修建圣特雷萨堡。1777年圣伊尔德丰索条约签订后，西班牙与葡萄牙勘界委员在舒伊会合，开始划定边界。

english:
The Chuya runs for 512 kilometres through Buryatia and Irkutsk Oblast, descending from upland mountains into a broader valley before reaching the Lena near the settlement of Chuya. Its basin covers 18,400 square kilometres, and the final fifty-two kilometres take the name Bolshaya Chuya. Forested plateau, floodplain and rocky channels shape a river whose flow varies sharply with snowmelt and summer rain.

The confluence lay on routes linking the upper Vitim country with the Lena and the districts around Lake Baikal. Evenki and other Tungusic communities hunted, fished and moved through the valleys, while river crossings served travelers carrying furs, metal and food. Boats and winter ice created different seasonal routes, and the confluence offered a recognizable meeting point between tributary and main river.

Mica deposits later brought mining settlements to the upper basin, but the older landscape remained one of forest, fish and seasonal movement. Salmon-like lenok, whitefish, grayling and taimen inhabited the varied currents. The Chuya therefore belonged to a Siberian world where tributaries, portage routes and winter crossings joined remote communities long before industrial mining changed parts of the valley.
simp_chinese:
楚亚河全长五百一十二公里，流经布里亚特与伊尔库茨克州，从高地山区进入宽阔谷地，最后在楚亚村附近汇入勒拿河。流域面积一万八千四百平方公里，最后五十二公里又称大楚亚河。森林高原、洪泛平原和岩石河槽共同构成长度变化明显的河道，水量受融雪和夏雨强烈影响。

河流汇口位于连接上维季姆地区、勒拿河及贝加尔湖周边县域的道路上。埃文基人和其他通古斯语社群在谷地中狩猎、捕鱼与迁徙，渡口则服务携带毛皮、金属和食物的旅人。船只与冬季冰面形成不同的季节路线，汇口为支流与主河相接提供醒目会合点。

后来云母矿把矿业聚落带到上游流域，旧有景观仍以森林、鱼类和季节迁徙为主。细鳞鲑、白鲑、茴鱼和哲罗鲑栖息于不同水流。楚亚因而属于这样的西伯利亚世界：支流、搬运小径和冬季渡口在工业采矿改变部分谷地以前，早已连接偏远社群。

english: The Chuyapi basin lies on the forested eastern slopes of the Andes, west of the Urubamba River. Its streams rise around the mountain of Urusayhua and descend through steep, humid valleys. The high ridges and warmer forest below contain a succession of different habitats, watered by frequent rain and mist. These waterways join the larger Urubamba basin, carrying mountain water toward the Amazonian lowlands.
simp_chinese: 楚亚皮流域位于安第斯山脉森林覆盖的东坡、乌鲁班巴河以西。溪流发源于乌鲁赛瓦山周围，穿过陡峭潮湿的谷地。高岭与下方较温暖的森林形成一系列不同的生境，雨水和雾气滋养着这里。水道汇入更大的乌鲁班巴流域，将山间水流带往亚马孙低地。

english: Chuzhboy was a churchyard district on the upper Suda, in the forested lands west of Belozero. It is mentioned in records of the fifteenth century and is associated with the site of Borisovo-Sudskoye. The Suda and its tributaries cut through a landscape of forests and waterways connecting Belozero with lands toward Lake Onega. Place names in the upper river basin bear traces of the Vepsian language, reflecting the area's older settlement history.
simp_chinese: 丘兹博伊是苏达河上游的一处教区，位于别洛奥泽罗以西的林地。十五世纪的文书提及此地，它与后来的鲍里索沃—苏德斯科耶所在地有关。苏达河及其支流穿过森林和水道交织的地带，将别洛奥泽罗与奥涅加湖方向的土地连接起来。上游流域的地名保留了维普斯语痕迹，反映这里更早的聚居历史。

english:
Chyhyryn stands on the Tiasmyn near the Dnieper, beneath the hill where its castle guarded the steppe frontier. Established as a fortified town under a royal privilege of 1589, it received Magdeburg rights in 1592. Its greatest prominence came as the seat of the Cossack hetmans and a centre of the emerging Hetmanate.

Bohdan Khmelnytsky made Chyhyryn his principal residence after the uprising of 1648. Its regiment became a leading formation of the Zaporozhian Host, and embassies and political decisions tied the town to the struggles for control of Ukraine. His successors faced competing Polish, Muscovite and Ottoman claims. Hetman Petro Doroshenko sought Ottoman protection but surrendered to Russian and Cossack forces in 1676. Ottoman armies besieged Chyhyryn in 1677 and again in 1678. The first assault failed; the second captured and destroyed the fortress and town. People later returned to the devastated district, and Chyhyryn was gradually resettled. In 1793 the second partition of Poland brought it under Russian rule.
simp_chinese:
奇希林位于第聂伯河附近的佳斯明河畔，城堡所在的高地守卫着草原边境。1589年的王室特许允许建立这座设防城镇，1592年它获得马格德堡法权。作为哥萨克盖特曼的驻地和新兴酋长国的中心，奇希林迎来了最显赫的时期。

1648年起义后，博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基将奇希林作为主要居所。当地哥萨克团成为扎波罗热军的重要部队，外交使节和政治决策使城镇卷入乌克兰控制权的争夺。他的继任者面对波兰、莫斯科和奥斯曼帝国相互竞争的主张。盖特曼彼得罗·多罗申科寻求奥斯曼保护，却于1676年向俄军和哥萨克军投降。奥斯曼军于1677年和1678年两次围攻奇希林。第一次进攻失败，第二次则攻陷并摧毁要塞和城镇。此后人们逐渐返回荒废的地区，奇希林得以重新定居。1793年第二次瓜分波兰后，它归俄国统治。

english: The Chylga flows through the mountain country of the upper Yana basin, between watersheds feeding the Sartang and the Adycha. Streams including the Symalabyt and Kharbalakh join it among the northern ridges. Forest and river valleys break up the highlands, while the rivers eventually carry their waters north to the Laptev Sea. Long winters and a short summer govern the movement of water through this inland landscape.
simp_chinese: 奇尔加河流经亚纳河上游山地，位于萨尔唐河与阿德恰河水系之间。瑟马拉贝特河和哈尔巴拉赫河等溪流在北方山岭间汇入。森林与河谷切割高地，河水最终向北流入拉普捷夫海。漫长冬季与短暂夏季支配这片内陆地区的水流。

sources.title: Приложение 9  Исходные материалы, использовавшиеся при разработке СКИОВОЯНА   .pdf

english:
Chymnaii belongs to the forested Aldan river country around Khandyga, where the river turns from a northward to a westward course. The Ulakhan-Bom and Sette-Daban ranges rise to the east, enclosing the valley in a broad Siberian setting. Long icy winters and immense distances made the river a decisive corridor, while surrounding forest supplied game, fish and timber.

Evenk and Yakut communities used the Aldan for seasonal fishing, hunting and transport. Winter tracks followed frozen channels and river terraces, while summer boats moved people and goods between scattered settlements. Fur, meat and fish entered exchange networks extending toward Yakutsk and the Lena basin.

The river bend and mountain barriers continued to organize movement long before roads reached the district. Chymnaii's identity therefore rests on a powerful waterway and the seasonal routes that connected forest communities across northeastern Siberia. Summer fish camps and winter hunting routes remained essential because roads were few and mountain passes difficult. The surrounding forests and upland barriers isolated settlements while shaping exchange. River journeys remained central.
simp_chinese:
钦纳伊属于汉德加周围林木覆盖的阿尔丹河地区。河流在附近由北流转向西流，乌拉汉博姆与谢泰达班山脉在东侧升起，围出广阔的西伯利亚谷地。漫长严冬和遥远距离使河道成为决定性的通行路线，周围森林则提供猎物、鱼类和木材。

埃文克人与雅库特人利用阿尔丹河进行季节捕鱼、狩猎和运输。冬季道路沿冻结河面和河流阶地延伸，夏季船只则在分散聚落之间运送人员与货物。毛皮、肉类和鱼类进入通往雅库茨克及勒拿河流域的交换网络。

在公路进入本区以前，河湾和山脉长期组织着往来。钦纳伊的身份因此来自一条强大的水道，以及连接东北西伯利亚森林社群的季节性路线。夏季渔营与冬季狩猎路线始终重要，因为可通行的道路稀少，山口又十分艰难。周围森林和高地屏障分隔聚落，也塑造交换网络。河上旅行始终处于核心地位。

english:
Chyormoz lies in the wooded Kama valley of Perm Krai, where small rivers descend through fir forest toward the great river. Iron deposits, timber and waterpower made the district suitable for metallurgy. Roads and winter sledge tracks connected scattered settlements before reservoirs altered the valley.

The settlement was founded in 1701. In 1763 Baron Nikolay Stroganov established a steel mill at the site, and the works later passed to Ivan Lazarev. Iron production linked charcoal burners, ore carriers and river boats to the powerful Ural industrial families. Woodland materials supplied fuel and building material while the Kama carried finished metal toward central Russia.

The mill and nearby villages formed a small industrial district. Workers combined factory labor with farming, fishing and seasonal transport. Chyormoz's early identity depended on the relationship between woodland, river and ironworks rather than on a major administrative centre. Ponds and forest supplied mill power and charcoal, while winter roads carried iron to the Kama and beyond.Factory managers recruited peasant labor for charcoal and transport, reinforcing links between industrial work and surrounding agriculture.
simp_chinese:
乔尔莫兹位于彼尔姆边疆区卡马河谷森林，小河穿过冷杉林流向大河。铁矿、木材和水力使地区适合冶金，道路与冬季雪橇线路在大型水库改变河谷以前连接分散聚落。

聚落建立于1701年。一七六三年，尼古拉·斯特罗加诺夫男爵在当地开设钢厂，工场后来转归伊万·拉扎列夫。冶铁把烧炭人、矿石运输者与河船连向强大的乌拉尔工业家族，森林提供燃料与建筑材料，卡马河则把成品金属运向俄罗斯中部。

工厂和附近村庄组成小型工业区。工人把工厂劳动同农业、捕鱼和季节运输结合。乔尔莫兹早期身份取决于林地、河流与铁厂之间的关系，而不是大型行政中心。池塘与森林提供磨坊水力和木炭，冬季道路把铁运往卡马河及更远地区。工厂管理者招募农民烧炭和运输，强化了工业劳动与周边农业的联系。

english:
Chyorny Yar, the “Black Bank,” was a fortified Russian settlement on the lower Volga, between Tsaritsyn and Astrakhan. Founded in 1627 by officers sent from Moscow, it guarded river traffic through the steppe. Its wooden and earthen defenses were rebuilt and strengthened as the riverbank and the demands of war altered the site.

During Stenka Razin's revolt in 1670 the fortress garrison joined the rebels and turned its guns against the tsar's army. It again changed allegiance during the Astrakhan revolt of 1705–1706, withstanding a siege by Kalmyk forces loyal to the tsar. Farther north, near the Solenikova fishing station, government troops defeated Yemelyan Pugachev's army in August 1774. The fortress had witnessed the Volga route's importance to rebels as well as to merchants and officials.
simp_chinese:
黑亚尔意为“黑色河岸”，是伏尔加河下游的一座俄国设防聚落，位于察里津与阿斯特拉罕之间。1627年，莫斯科派来的军官建立了这处据点，守卫穿过草原的河上交通。随着河岸变化和战争需要，木土防御工事得到重建和加强。

1670年斯坚卡·拉辛起义期间，堡垒守军加入叛军，将大炮转向沙皇军队。1705—1706年阿斯特拉罕起义时，守军再次改变立场，抵御了效忠沙皇的卡尔梅克军队围攻。1774年8月，政府军在更北方的索列尼科娃渔场附近击败叶梅利扬·普加乔夫的军队。这座堡垒见证了伏尔加河路线对叛军以及商人、官员的重要性。

english:
Ciaike lies in the cold grasslands of Aonikenk country in Patagonia, between the Andean foothills and the open plains. Strong winds, scattered springs and seasonal grass shaped movement. Guanaco, rhea and wild plants supplied food, hides and materials for shelter.

Aonikenk families, speakers of a Chonan language, travelled in mobile bands across huge distances. They used horses after European contact, extending their hunting range and trade networks. Hides, feathers and other products moved north and toward Atlantic settlements in exchange for metal, cloth and food.

Mapuche movement from the north and later state expansion transformed the region. Chilean and Argentine settlement took control of grasslands in the nineteenth century, while disease and violence caused catastrophic population loss. Ciaike's early identity belongs to the open Patagonian routes of the Aonikenk before those changes. Waterholes and sheltered valleys shaped seasonal camps, while horses later allowed families to follow guanaco herds over greater distances.Mobility also tied the grasslands to Atlantic and Andean exchange routes, where hides and feathers were traded for metal and cloth. Water shaped where families could camp.
simp_chinese:
恰伊克位于巴塔哥尼亚Aonikenk人寒冷草原，处于安第斯山麓与开阔平原之间。强风、零散泉眼和季节草场决定迁徙。原驼、美洲鸵和野生植物提供食物、兽皮与住所材料。

Aonikenk家庭使用乔南语系语言，以大范围移动的群体生活。欧洲接触后引入马匹，扩大狩猎范围与贸易网络。兽皮、羽毛等物产向北及大西洋岸聚落交换金属、布匹和粮食。

北方马普切迁徙和后来的国家扩张改变地区。十九世纪智利与阿根廷定居者控制草原，疫病和暴力造成灾难性人口损失。恰伊克的早期身份属于这些变化以前Aonikenk人的开放巴塔哥尼亚道路。水潭与避风谷地决定季节营地，马匹后来使家庭能更远追随原驼群。流动又把草原同大西洋岸及安第斯交换路线相连，以兽皮和羽毛换取金属与布匹。季节性兽群与水源决定群体何时会合或分散。水源决定家庭能在哪里扎营。

english:
Cianjur lies along a principal inland road between Jakarta, roughly 120 kilometres to the northwest, and Bandung, about sixty kilometres to the east. This position made the West Javanese town a natural stopping point where lowland roads met routes into the cooler uplands. Cianjur was founded in 1677. Its first head was R. A. Wiratanudatar I, known as Dalem Cikundul, who traced descent from the old Sundanese city of Pajajaran.

The settlement therefore grew with an explicit link to an earlier center of Sundanese authority. The surrounding landscape receives abundant tropical rain. Heavy rainfall lasts from October through May, while June through September brings a comparatively moderate period.

Moisture supports dense vegetation and gives the area its character as a gateway between the Jakarta lowlands and the heights toward Bandung. In later periods, local crafts broadened the town's economy beyond transport and farming. Leatherwork, woodworking, metal crafts, weaving, and pottery formed a varied small-scale manufacturing tradition. Cianjur's identity is rooted in road travel, mountain water, craft production, and its founding lineage.
simp_chinese:
展玉位于爪哇西部一条重要内陆道路上：向西北约120公里可到雅加达，向东约60公里可达万隆。这一位置使城镇成为低地道路与通往上凉高地路线的自然交汇点。展玉建立于1677年，首任首领是拉登·阿里亚·维拉塔努达塔尔一世，又名达勒姆·芝昆杜尔，其祖先可追溯到古巽他城市巴查查兰。

因此，这处聚落从建立之初便与更早的巽他权力中心相连。周围地区雨量丰沛，属于热带雨林气候。十月至次年五月降雨强烈，六月至九月则相对缓和。充足水分滋养了茂密植被，也让展玉成为雅加达低地同万隆方向高地之间的门户。

较晚时期，手工业使城镇经济超出交通和农业的范围，皮革、木作、金属加工、编织与陶器共同组成多样的小规模制造传统。展玉的地方特色由山路交通、山地水源、手工业生产与建立者世系共同构成。

english: Cibadak lies in the river country of western Java, near the Cicatih. Stones found beside the river bear the Sanghyang Tapak inscription, dated 1030, in which the Sunda ruler Sri Jayabupati established a sacred area and forbade the taking of fish from a protected stretch of water. Written in Old Javanese, the inscription invokes a curse upon anyone who breaks the prohibition. It is among the early written witnesses to the kingdom of Sunda.
simp_chinese: 芝巴达位于爪哇西部的河流地区，靠近芝加蒂河。河畔发现的石碑刻有1030年的桑扬·塔帕克铭文，巽他统治者斯里·查亚布帕蒂在文中设立圣地，禁止在受保护的河段捕鱼。铭文以古爪哇语写成，对违反禁令者发出诅咒，是巽他王国早期的文字见证之一。

english: The Chibagalakh rises in the range that bears its name and flows into the Indigirka from the left. Near its source the river passes through high Lake Tabanda, more than a thousand metres above sea level. Boulders fill its channel, which divides into branches and rushes through rapids and turbulent shallows. When the water rises, this mountain river becomes especially swift and dangerous.
simp_chinese: 奇巴加拉赫河发源于同名山脉，从左岸汇入因迪吉尔卡河。靠近源头处，河水流经海拔千米以上的高山湖泊塔班达湖。河床遍布巨石，河道时而分汊，穿过急流和湍急浅滩。水位上涨时，这条山地河流变得格外迅猛危险。

english: Cibal was a local realm in the mountainous Manggarai country of western Flores. Early accounts remember it as an inland kingdom, distinct from the ports along the northern coast. Manggarai communities were organised under local rulers called dalu and smaller village and lineage leaders. From the seventeenth century the sultanate of Bima on Sumbawa exercised influence over the northwestern coast, with representatives at ports such as Reo mediating between its court and Manggarai chiefs.
simp_chinese: 芝巴尔是弗洛勒斯西部曼加莱山区的地方政权。早期记载将它描述为内陆王国，有别于北岸的港口。曼加莱社群由称为达鲁的地方统治者以及村庄和宗族首领组织起来。自十七世纪起，松巴哇的比马苏丹国在西北岸施加影响，并在雷奥等港口派驻代表，在王廷与曼加莱首领之间居中往来。

english:
The Cibao is the broad valley and mountain country of northern Hispaniola, where rivers descend between the island’s principal ranges. Its fertile plains formed part of Maguá, the Taíno chiefdom associated with Guarionex. Early Spanish visitors heard of gold in Cibao, a name they recorded during their first explorations.

After founding La Isabela on the northern coast, Columbus established a fort called Concepción in the Cibao valley near the country of Guarionex. Spanish demands for tribute and control over gold-bearing lands brought conflict with Indigenous leaders. Guarionex accepted tribute demands after the military defeat of several allied Indigenous chiefs in 1495. The valley became a focus of conquest, settlement and exploitation, linking the north coast with the interior of the island.
simp_chinese:
锡瓦奥是伊斯帕尼奥拉北部广阔的河谷与山地，河流在岛屿主要山脉之间流淌。肥沃平原属于与泰诺首领瓜里奥内克斯有关的马瓜酋邦。早期西班牙访客听闻锡瓦奥有黄金，并在最初的探索中记录了这个名称。

哥伦布在北岸建立伊莎贝拉后，又在锡瓦奥河谷、瓜里奥内克斯的地域附近修筑康塞普西翁堡。西班牙人索取贡赋并控制含金土地，与原住民首领发生冲突。1495年结盟的首领战败后，瓜里奥内克斯接受了贡赋要求。河谷成为征服、定居与开采的焦点，连接北岸和岛屿内陆。

english: Cibuaya lies on the low northern coast of western Java, in the country of Karawang. Brick foundations and images of Vishnu testify to an early Hindu religious centre here. The stone sculptures, dated to around the seventh century, belong to the wider world of Tarumanagara, a kingdom known from inscriptions in western Java. Pottery fragments and other remains found among the ruins recall the community that once inhabited this coastal plain.
simp_chinese: 芝布亚位于爪哇西部北岸的低地，属于卡拉旺地区。砖砌建筑遗址和毗湿奴神像显示，这里曾是一处早期印度教中心。这些约七世纪的石雕与多罗摩那伽罗的广阔世界有关；西爪哇的铭文记载了这个王国。遗址中的陶片及其他遗存，让人想起曾居住在这片海岸平原上的社群。

english:
Cicia is a compact island in Fiji's northern Lau group, built from volcanic rock and raised coral. Its 34.6 square kilometres support five villages—Lomati, Mabula, Naceva, Natokalau and Tarakua—along shores and paths separated by groves and garden land. A reef and exposed coast make access from the sea dependent on weather.

Tarakua is the chiefly village, and its chief holds paramount status on the island. Cicia belonged to northern Lau, whose islands looked toward Cakaudrove within Fiji and toward Tonga across the eastern sea. Chiefly alliances, tribute and canoe travel linked villages to larger networks before European missions and trade became prominent in Lau.

Coconut groves and copra formed the main export economy, while gardens, fishing and timber supported households. Women wove mats and barkcloth, and hardwoods from Lau were valued for building large sailing canoes. These vessels carried people, food and prestige goods between islands and connected Cicia to Tonga even when authority remained local. The island's low shores, raised coral and volcanic soils forced households to combine maritime skill with careful cultivation of small holdings.
simp_chinese:
奇西亚是斐济北部劳群岛中的紧凑岛屿，由火山岩和隆起珊瑚构成。全岛面积34.6平方公里，洛马蒂、马布拉、纳塞瓦、纳托卡劳和塔拉库阿五个村庄分布在海岸与小径旁，村庄之间隔着椰林和园地。礁盘与暴露海岸使海上进出取决于天气。

塔拉库阿是酋长村，其酋长在全岛拥有最高地位。奇西亚属于北劳群岛，当地既同斐济境内的卡考德罗韦保持关系，也隔着东部海域与汤加往来。欧洲传教活动与贸易在劳群岛扩大以前，酋长联盟、贡赋和独木舟航行已把村庄纳入更大的网络。

椰林和椰干构成主要出口经济，园圃、捕鱼和木材维持家庭生活。妇女编织席垫与树皮布，劳群岛坚硬木材则适合建造大型帆船。这些船只运载人员、食物和声望物品，即使地方权威保持独立，也把奇西亚同汤加连通。低缓海岸、隆起珊瑚和火山土迫使居民兼用航海技艺与精细的小块土地利用。

english:
Ciechanów grew around the castle of the dukes of Mazovia on the Łydynia. Built in the fourteenth century on an island at a bend in the river, the brick fortress replaced an earlier wooden stronghold and became a seat of ducal authority. Its towers and walls were raised during later alterations, giving it a commanding presence above the low, marshy ground beside the winding Łydynia river.

After the last Masovian dukes died without heirs, Ciechanów passed with Mazovia to the Polish Crown in 1526. Royal officials administered the castle, whose earlier political importance diminished. Swedish invasions in 1657 and 1708 damaged the town and fortress, and the castle fell increasingly into ruin. Ciechanów nevertheless remained a centre for the surrounding northern Masovian lands.
simp_chinese:
切哈努夫围绕瓦迪尼亚河畔马佐夫舍公爵的城堡发展。十四世纪，砖造要塞建在河湾中的岛上，取代更早的木造据点，成为公爵权力的驻地。后来的改建加高了城墙和塔楼，使城堡耸立于河畔低洼湿地之上。

最后的马佐夫舍公爵无嗣去世后，切哈努夫于1526年随马佐夫舍一同归入波兰王室。王室官员管理城堡，其旧日政治地位逐渐下降。1657年和1708年的瑞典入侵损毁了城镇与要塞，城堡日益荒废。然而切哈努夫仍是周围马佐夫舍北部地区的中心。

english: Cienfuegos Bay, also known as the Bay of Jagua, is a deep and sheltered harbour on Cuba’s south coast. A narrow entrance leads into its broad inner waters. In 1819 settlers, many of French origin, founded the colony of Fernandina de Jagua on the bay under Spanish rule. The harbour offered a protected outlet for the surrounding region and helped shape the town that became Cienfuegos.
simp_chinese: 西恩富戈斯湾又称哈瓜湾，是古巴南岸一处深而受庇护的港湾。狭窄入口通向宽阔的内湾。1819年，许多具有法国背景的移民在西班牙统治下于湾畔建立费尔南迪纳德哈瓜殖民地。港湾为周围地区提供了受保护的出海口，也影响了后来称为西恩富戈斯的城镇的发展。

english: Cieza stands by the Segura amid the orchards of Murcia. Its position near the frontier of the Nasrid kingdom exposed the town to raids during the long struggle with Granada. On Easter Sunday in 1477 a Granadan force attacked Cieza and carried away many of its inhabitants as captives. The raid left the settlement depopulated and became a defining episode in its history.
simp_chinese: 锡耶萨位于穆尔西亚的果园地带，坐落在塞古拉河畔。它靠近纳斯里德王国边境，在与格拉纳达的长期斗争中容易遭到袭击。1477年复活节的星期日，格拉纳达军队进攻锡耶萨，掳走许多居民。袭击使聚落人口锐减，成为当地历史上的重大事件。

english:
The Ciguayos inhabited northeastern Hispaniola, including the Samaná Peninsula and nearby coast. Early Spanish writers distinguished their language from the Taíno speech of other parts of the island, as well as from that of their northern Macorix neighbors. Their communities occupied a landscape of hills, bays and forested coast before the arrival of Europeans.

In January 1493 Columbus’s ships reached the vicinity of Samaná Bay during their return voyage. An encounter with Indigenous men carrying bows and arrows ended in fighting, and the Spaniards named the bay for the arrows they had seen. The people encountered there are often identified as Ciguayos. Their language and independence would be profoundly affected by the rapid territorial expansion of Spanish colonial rule on Hispaniola.
simp_chinese:
西瓜约人居住在伊斯帕尼奥拉东北部，包括萨马纳半岛及附近海岸。早期西班牙作者指出，他们的语言不同于岛上其他地区的泰诺语和马科里克斯邻人的语言。欧洲人抵达之前，他们的社群生活在丘陵、海湾与森林海岸交织的地域。

1493年1月，哥伦布船队在返航途中抵达萨马纳湾附近。船员与持弓箭的原住民相遇，冲突随之发生；西班牙人以所见箭矢为海湾命名。这里遇到的人常被认作西瓜约人。西班牙统治迅速扩展，深刻影响了他们的语言与独立生活。

english: Cihuatlan was a tributary province on the Pacific coast of southern Mexico, in the country around Zihuatanejo. Its lands extended between the Balsas River and the vicinity of Acapulco, with the Sierra Madre del Sur rising inland. The tribute records of the Mexica represented the province with the glyph of a woman’s head. After the Spanish conquest, the sheltered bay of Zihuatanejo became a point of departure for voyages across the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 锡瓦特兰是墨西哥南部太平洋沿岸的贡赋省，位于今锡瓦塔内霍一带。其土地从巴尔萨斯河延伸至阿卡普尔科附近，内陆耸立着南马德雷山脉。墨西加人的贡赋记录以女性头像字形代表这一省。西班牙征服后，受庇护的锡瓦塔内霍湾成为横越太平洋航行的出发地。

english: Cikakw Sipi, the “skunk river” of the Atikamekw, winds through the forest country west of the Saint-Maurice. Known also as the Vermillon, it runs for some 160 kilometres, broken by waterfalls and rapids before joining the larger river. Its valley lies within Nitaskinan, the Atikamekw homeland, where families travelled between fishing waters and hunting grounds. The Abenaki knew the same river by other names, including Azobakhigan, “where one paddles quickly”.
simp_chinese: 奇卡克西比在阿蒂卡梅克语中意为“臭鼬河”，蜿蜒流过圣莫里斯河以西的森林地带。它也被称为韦尔米永河，全长约160公里，途中有瀑布和急流，最终汇入圣莫里斯河。河谷位于阿蒂卡梅克人的家园尼塔斯基南之内，家庭往返于渔场与猎场之间。阿贝纳基人也有自己的名称，其中阿佐巴基根意为“快速划行之处”。

english: Cílì lies in the Lǐ River valley of northwestern Hunan, where waterways emerge from the Wǔlíng mountains. The county became Cílì Zhou under the Yuan, then returned to county status in the early Ming. In 1390 the Ming established Jiǔxī Guard in the district, with several subordinate military posts. The Qing abolished the guard during its reorganisation of the region in the early eighteenth century, when native chiefships were replaced by directly appointed officials and new counties were created.
simp_chinese: 慈利位于湖南西北澧水谷地，河流从武陵山区向东流出。元代慈利升为州，明初又降为县。洪武二十三年（1390年），朝廷在此设九溪卫，统辖多个军所。清雍正年间改土归流，重组地方建置，裁撤九溪卫并另设县治。

english: The Cimanuk flows north through western Java to the Java Sea near Indramayu. Its estuary was known to Portuguese visitors as Chemano, a port on the eastern edge of the Sunda kingdom. In the early sixteenth century Tomé Pires described it as a boundary of that realm, whose other ports farther west carried pepper into the maritime trade. The river's changing mouths spread across the low coastal plain as it reaches the sea.
simp_chinese: 芝马努克河向北流过爪哇西部，在因德拉马尤附近注入爪哇海。葡萄牙人称其河口港为切马诺，它位于巽他王国东部边缘。十六世纪初，托梅·皮雷斯将这里记作该国的边界；巽他更西面的港口则将胡椒送入海上贸易。河流流向海洋时，在低平海岸上形成了不断变化的河口。

english: Cincu was a Saxon settlement in southern Transylvania, centred on a church dedicated to the Virgin Mary. The large Romanesque basilica served both worship and the security of its community. Between 1522 and 1526 the church was fortified, as inscriptions in its choir and nave record. Its walls and towers offered a place of refuge in a country exposed to raids and war. The building was altered again after the Ottoman threat receded and after a fire in 1789, preserving traces of several periods in the life of the settlement.
simp_chinese: 钦库是特兰西瓦尼亚南部的萨克森聚落，以献给圣母玛利亚的教堂为中心。大型罗马式圣殿既供礼拜，也关乎社区安全。唱诗班席和中殿的铭文记载，教堂在1522至1526年间得到加固。当地屡受袭击与战争威胁，城墙和塔楼为居民提供避难之所。奥斯曼威胁消退后及1789年火灾后，建筑再次改建，保留了聚落不同时期的痕迹。

english: Çine lies in the valley of a tributary of the Büyük Menderes, south of the main river plain. At Old Çine stands the Ahmed Gazi mosque, a large stone building associated with the Menteşe principality. Its broad dome and thick walls make it a notable example of medieval Turkish architecture in western Anatolia. The settlement and the river valley connected the Menteşe mountain country with the cultivated lands to the north.
simp_chinese: 奇内位于大门德雷斯河一条支流的河谷，在干流平原以南。旧奇内有艾哈迈德加齐清真寺，这座大型石造建筑与门泰谢公国有关。宽阔圆顶和厚实墙体使它成为安纳托利亚西部中世纪突厥建筑的突出实例。聚落与河谷将门泰谢山地与北方耕地相连。

english: The Circassian coast lies beneath the western Caucasus, where wooded mountains approach the Black Sea. Bays and river mouths give access to the lands of the peoples known to medieval merchants as Circassians and Zikhs. Genoese traders maintained contacts and coastal posts in the region, linking it with Caffa and the ports near the Kerch Strait. The sea connected these mountain shores to a wider network of exchange.
simp_chinese: 切尔克斯海岸位于西高加索山麓，林木覆盖的山地逼近黑海。海湾与河口通向中世纪商人所称的切尔克斯人和齐赫人居住的土地。热那亚商人在这一地区保持贸易联系并设立沿海据点，将其与卡法和刻赤海峡附近的港口相连。大海使山地海岸融入更广阔的交换网络。

english: Danzhit Khànlai lies where the Yukon River emerges towards the broad flats of interior Alaska. Birch Creek joins the great river nearby, crossing wetlands and forest on its way from the uplands. The surrounding country was used by Gwich’in people who hunted and fished along these waters. The Dendoo Gwich’in lived in the Birch Creek country, while the Gwichyaa Gwich’in are associated with the Yukon Flats farther downstream.
simp_chinese: 丹日特汗赖位于育空河流向阿拉斯加内陆广阔平原的地方。附近的桦树溪从高地而来，穿过湿地和森林，汇入大河。周围地区是哥威迅人沿水道狩猎捕鱼的地方。登杜哥威迅人居于桦树溪地区，哥威亚哥威迅人则与下游的育空平原有关。

english:
Cirebon is a port on the north coast of Java, where Sundanese and Javanese worlds meet. Once a small coastal settlement, it became the seat of an Islamic sultanate and a centre of trade and religious learning. Its name is associated with the little shrimp called rebon, gathered along the coast and used to make shrimp paste. The city's royal palaces preserve the memory of its ruling houses.

Local chronicles trace Cirebon's growth to the fifteenth century, when the settlement of Caruban attracted people from the coast and the interior. Sunan Gunungjati is traditionally credited with establishing its independence from the Sunda kingdom in 1482 and spreading Islam in western Java. During the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries Cirebon prospered as a port and centre of Islamic scholarship. In 1677 the ruling house divided: the princes of Kasepuhan and Kanoman held separate palaces and domains, while Wangsakerta maintained a court devoted to learning. Dutch influence subsequently grew, and a further succession dispute produced the Kacirebonan line in 1807.
simp_chinese:
芝勒本是爪哇北岸的港口，处于巽他与爪哇文化交会之地。它由一处小型海岸聚落发展为伊斯兰苏丹国的都城，也是贸易和宗教学问的中心。城名与海岸采捕、用来制作虾酱的小虾勒本有关。城内的王宫保存着各统治家族的记忆。

地方编年史将芝勒本的兴起追溯至十五世纪，当时卡鲁班聚落吸引了来自海岸与内陆的居民。传统认为，苏南古农贾蒂于1482年使其脱离巽他王国独立，并在西爪哇传播伊斯兰教。十六至十七世纪，芝勒本作为港口和伊斯兰学术中心繁荣起来。1677年统治家族分裂：卡瑟普汉和卡诺曼两位王子各有宫殿及领地，旺萨克尔塔则主持一处致力于学问的王廷。此后荷兰影响日增，1807年的另一场继承争端又产生了卡芝勒本南一支。

english: Cirebon Bay lies on the low northern coast of Java, opening onto the Java Sea. Rivers descend from the interior across a gently sloping plain to the bay, where sediment shapes the shoreline. The port of Muara Jati and the kingdom of Cirebon grew on this coast, drawing merchants through the sea routes of the Indonesian archipelago.
simp_chinese: 井里汶湾位于爪哇北部低平海岸，向爪哇海敞开。河流从内陆穿过缓坡平原抵达海湾，泥沙塑造着岸线。穆阿拉查蒂港与井里汶王国在这片海岸兴起，吸引商人沿印度尼西亚群岛的海路前来。

english: Cirencester stands in the Cotswolds on the site of the Roman town of Corinium. In the Middle Ages it became prosperous through the wool trade, and the tombs of wealthy merchants in the parish church testify to that wealth. Houses built of local stone lined the streets of the market town. During the Civil War Royalist troops stormed Cirencester in February 1643 and held it until 1645.
simp_chinese: 赛伦塞斯特位于科茨沃尔德，建在罗马城镇科里尼乌姆旧址上。中世纪它因羊毛贸易繁荣，教区教堂内富商的墓碑见证了这份财富。当地石材建造的房屋排列在集镇街道上。英国内战期间，王党军队于1643年2月攻陷赛伦塞斯特，并占据至1645年。

english: The Citará mountains form part of the Western Cordillera between the Cauca valley and the humid forests of Chocó. Their slopes drain toward the Atrato and San Juan basins, while high ridges rise above the cloud forest. Citará was also the name of Indigenous communities encountered by Spanish missionaries in the upper Atrato region. Heavy Pacific rainfall sustains streams and forests across the western slopes.
simp_chinese: 西塔拉山地属于西部山脉，位于考卡河谷与乔科湿润森林之间。山坡的河水流向阿特拉托河与圣胡安河流域，高耸山脊立于云雾森林之上。西塔拉也是西班牙传教士在阿特拉托河上游遇见的原住民社群的名称。太平洋带来的丰沛降雨滋养西坡的溪流与森林。

english: Citlaltépetl, the “Star Mountain”, rises above the eastern edge of the Mexican highlands. Also known as Pico de Orizaba, it is the highest mountain in Mexico, its volcanic cone visible across the plains and valleys below. The volcano erupted repeatedly during the colonial period; reports record ash, explosions and lava in the middle of the sixteenth century. Snow on its upper slopes distinguishes the peak from the warmer lands toward the Gulf coast.
simp_chinese: 锡特拉尔特佩特尔意为“星山”，耸立在墨西哥高地东缘。这座火山又称奥里萨瓦峰，是墨西哥最高的山，火山锥从远处的平原和谷地清晰可见。殖民时期它曾多次喷发；十六世纪中叶的记载提及火山灰、爆炸和熔岩。高处的积雪使山峰有别于通向墨西哥湾沿岸的温暖地带。

english:
Città di Castello lies in the upper Tiber valley, between the Apennines and the hills of Umbria. Its medieval commune was drawn into struggles between papal, imperial and neighbouring powers. In the fifteenth century the Vitelli family emerged from fierce local rivalries to dominate the city and patronize its artistic life.

In 1474 papal forces under Giuliano della Rovere besieged the city for 67 days without taking it. Niccolò Vitelli, who had been expelled, returned in 1482 with support from Florence and was recognized as lord. The family encouraged artists and printing, giving the city a distinctive Renaissance character. Their rule ended after the execution of Vitellozzo Vitelli and the seizure of the city by Cesare Borgia; it later returned to papal control.
simp_chinese:
城堡城位于台伯河上游谷地，处在亚平宁山脉与翁布里亚丘陵之间。中世纪公社卷入教廷、帝国和邻近势力之间的斗争。十五世纪，维泰利家族从激烈的地方竞争中崛起，掌控城市并赞助艺术。

1474年，朱利亚诺·德拉罗韦雷率领的教皇军队围攻此城67天，却未能攻克。曾被驱逐的尼科洛·维泰利于1482年在佛罗伦萨支持下返回，并被承认为领主。家族支持艺术家和印刷业，使城市形成鲜明的文艺复兴风貌。维泰洛佐·维泰利被处死、切萨雷·博尔贾夺取城市后，家族统治结束；此地后来回到教廷控制之下。

english:
Città Ducale stands on a hill above the Velino valley, near the old frontier of the Kingdom of Naples. Charles II of Anjou founded the town in 1308 and named it for his son Robert, Duke of Calabria. Its walls and planned streets formed a royal settlement commanding a route through the mountains. Its position placed it near the lands of the Papal States as well as the towns of Abruzzo.

Earthquakes repeatedly damaged the town. After a severe shock in 1703, its cathedral required extensive rebuilding. During French rule Città Ducale became the seat of a subprefecture in 1808 and a district capital in 1810. Bourbon government returned in 1815, but the town retained its role as a centre for the mountain communities around the Velino.
simp_chinese:
杜卡莱城坐落在维利诺河谷上方的山丘，靠近那不勒斯王国的旧边界。安茹的查理二世于1308年创建城镇，以其子、卡拉布里亚公爵罗贝尔命名。城墙与规划街道组成王室聚落，控制穿山道路。它靠近教宗国土地，也与阿布鲁佐各城镇相连。

地震屡次损坏城镇。1703年强震后，大教堂需要大规模重建。法国统治期间，杜卡莱城于1808年成为副省署所在地，1810年成为区首府。1815年波旁政权恢复，城镇仍是维利诺河周围山地社群的中心。

english: Ciudad Real began as Villa Real, founded by Alfonso X in 1255 near the older settlement of Alarcos. Its royal privileges made it a counterweight to the extensive lands of the Order of Calatrava. In 1420 John II raised Villa Real to the rank of city in recognition of its support against the military orders. Later in the fifteenth century the city acquired important royal institutions, including a tribunal of the Inquisition and a royal chancery.
simp_chinese: 雷阿尔城最初名为皇家镇，由阿方索十世于1255年在古老的阿拉科斯聚落附近建立。王室特权使其成为制衡卡拉特拉瓦骑士团广大领地的力量。1420年，胡安二世为表彰该镇支持王室对抗军事修会，将其升格为城市。十五世纪后期，这里又设立宗教裁判所和皇家高等法院等重要王室机构。

english:
Ciudad Rodrigo stands above the Águeda near the Portuguese frontier. King Ferdinand II of León walled the town in the twelfth century and founded its bishopric and cathedral, and Enrique II of Castile built its castle in 1372. It was, with Tuy and Badajoz, one of the three main fortresses of the Castilian crown facing Portugal, and in 1384 a Castilian army set out from here for Portugal, to meet defeat at Aljubarrota the next year. The town's Jewish community kept its synagogue until July 1492, and the town was a crossing point for Jewish exiles from Castile bound for Portugal.

After the wars of the seventeenth century the defences were strengthened with ditches, bastions and outworks. In the Peninsular War Marshal Ney took Ciudad Rodrigo on 10 July 1810 after a siege of more than two months. On the night of 19 January 1812 Wellington's army stormed the town through two breaches in the walls, at the cost of the lives of the generals Mackinnon and Craufurd. The Spanish crown gave Wellington the title of Duke of Ciudad Rodrigo, but the sieges left the walls and the old town badly damaged.
simp_chinese:
罗德里戈城位于葡萄牙边境附近的阿圭达河上方。莱昂国王费尔南多二世在十二世纪修筑了城墙，并设立了主教区和大教堂；卡斯蒂利亚的恩里克二世于1372年修建了城堡。它与图伊、巴达霍斯同为卡斯蒂利亚王国面对葡萄牙的三大要塞，1384年一支卡斯蒂利亚军队从这里出发进入葡萄牙，次年在阿尔茹巴罗塔战败。城里的犹太社区保有自己的会堂，直到1492年7月，这里也是被逐出卡斯蒂利亚、前往葡萄牙的犹太人的过境点。

十七世纪战争之后，防御工事增建了壕沟、棱堡和外围工事。半岛战争中，内伊元帅在围攻两个多月后于1810年7月10日攻占罗德里戈城。1812年1月19日夜，威灵顿的军队从城墙的两处缺口攻入城中，麦金农和克劳福德两位将军在战斗中阵亡。西班牙王室授予威灵顿“罗德里戈城公爵”的头衔，但两次围攻使城墙和老城遭到严重破坏。

english: Ciutadella occupies a narrow inlet at the western end of Menorca. Known as Medina Menurqa under Muslim rule, it passed to the Crown of Aragon in 1287. James II of Majorca strengthened its walls in 1303, but in 1558 an Ottoman raid devastated the town. The people of Ciutadella remembered the attack as the Year of the Disaster.
simp_chinese: 休塔德利亚坐落在梅诺卡岛西端的一处狭长海湾。穆斯林统治时，这座城称为梅迪纳梅努尔卡，1287年转归阿拉贡王室。马略卡的海梅二世于1303年加强城墙，但1558年奥斯曼人的袭击仍重创了城镇。休塔德利亚居民将那一年铭记为“灾难之年”。

english:
Cividale stands on the Natisone at the foot of the eastern Alps. Founded by the Romans as Forum Iulii, it gave its name to Friuli and later became the seat of a Lombard duchy. The patriarchs of Aquileia also resided here, leaving churches and monuments that recall the town's early importance.

Cividale had been chosen as the capital of the patriarchal state in 1077. The patriarchs' move to Udine in 1238 sharpened rivalry between the two cities. In 1409 Pope Gregory XII held a council at Cividale during the Western Schism, but it attracted little support. The Republic of Venice annexed the town in 1420, bringing it into its mainland state. Cividale's older religious and civic buildings remained as reminders of its Lombard and patriarchal past.
simp_chinese:
奇维达莱位于东阿尔卑斯山麓的纳蒂索内河畔。罗马人在此建立尤利乌斯广场，弗留利的名称即源于此；后来它成为伦巴第公国的驻地。阿奎莱亚宗主教也曾居住在这里，留下教堂和纪念建筑，见证城镇早期的重要地位。

1077年，奇维达莱被选为宗主教国的首都。1238年，宗主教迁往乌迪内，加深了两城的竞争。1409年，西方教会大分裂期间，教皇额我略十二世在奇维达莱召开会议，但得到的支持很少。1420年，威尼斯共和国吞并此城，将它纳入大陆领地。古老的宗教与市政建筑仍使人想起它的伦巴第和宗主教时代。

english:
Civitavecchia is a harbour on the Tyrrhenian coast northwest of Rome. Its ancient predecessor, Centumcellae, developed around the port enlarged by Emperor Trajan in the early second century. After repeated raids in the early Middle Ages, inhabitants returned to the old coastal site and rebuilt it under the name Civitas Vetus.

The popes granted the town to various lords, including the Di Vico. In 1431 Pope Eugene IV sent Cardinal Giovanni Vitelleschi and his commanders to recover it; thereafter it was governed as a papal possession by a vicar and a treasurer appointed to administer the town. Its harbour became Rome's principal port, and in 1696 Pope Innocent XII declared it a free port. French forces occupied Civitavecchia in 1806 during the Napoleonic era.
simp_chinese:
奇维塔韦基亚是罗马西北方第勒尼安海岸的一座港口。它的古代前身森图姆凯莱围绕图拉真皇帝于二世纪初扩建的港口发展起来。中世纪早期屡遭劫掠之后，居民回到海岸上的旧址重建城镇，称其为“旧城”，即奇维塔斯韦图斯。

教皇曾将此城封给不同领主，其中包括迪维科家族。1431年，教皇尤金四世派枢机乔瓦尼·维泰莱斯基及其将领收复此地，此后城镇由教廷派遣的代理人和司库治理。港口成为罗马的主要海港，1696年教皇英诺森十二世将其宣布为自由港。拿破仑时代的1806年，法国军队占领了奇维塔韦基亚。

english:
Ciwat belongs to the Louisiana country of the Chitimacha, whose ancestral lands extended through the swamps, bayous and rivers of the Atchafalaya Basin and the Mississippi Delta. The Chitimacha knew these waterways closely and used their natural obstacles as defence; their villages were generally large and unfortified. Houses were built from poles, mud and palmetto leaves, with thatched roofs.

Women cultivated many varieties of corn, beans, squash and melons, while men hunted deer, turkey and alligator and caught fish. Cypress dugout canoes carried people and goods through the wetlands, and the largest could hold dozens of passengers. The Chitimacha also used their environment to support a distinct social and ceremonial life, including a matrilineal system of descent and property. Their language was a language isolate, unrelated to neighboring families.

Disease, war and settlement pressure reduced the population sharply after European contact, yet the people retained a small part of their original territory near Bayou Teche, unlike any other Louisiana tribe. In the twentieth century the last fluent speakers died, but tribal members later used notes and recordings from around to teach the language again. The waterways remain central to understanding the Chitimacha past and their continued community life.
simp_chinese:
西瓦特属于路易斯安那的奇蒂马查地区。他们的祖地延伸至阿查法拉亚盆地与密西西比河三角洲的沼泽、河汊和河道之间。奇蒂马查人熟悉这片水网，也依靠天然障碍防御；村落通常规模较大，并不修筑城墙。房屋以木杆搭成框架，用泥土或棕榈叶填覆，屋顶铺茅草。

妇女种植多种玉米、豆类、南瓜和甜瓜，男子则猎取鹿、火鸡和短吻鳄，并捕鱼为生。柏木独木舟承担运输，大船可载数十人。奇蒂马查人也由环境塑造出独特的社会与礼仪生活，并实行母系传承和财产继承。

他们的语言属于孤立语言，与邻近语系没有亲缘关系。欧洲人到来后，疫病、战争与定居压力使人口锐减，但他们仍在泰什河附近保留了原居地的一小部分，这在路易斯安那各原住民族中十分少见。二十世纪最后几位流利使用者去世后，族人又借助约1930年的笔记和录音恢复语言教学。河流与沼泽仍是理解奇蒂马查历史及其延续至今的社群生活的核心。

english: Cixi was established as a county in 738, with its seat west of Ningbo. To the north, the shore of Hangzhou Bay changed as silt accumulated and land emerged from the sea. The Dagu seawall protected the coastal plain, while salt works operated along its edge. From the Ming through the Qing, the embankment was repeatedly repaired and strengthened as communities adapted to the shifting coast.
simp_chinese: 慈溪于738年设县，县治在宁波以西。北面的杭州湾海岸随泥沙淤积而不断变化，海中逐渐出现新地。大古塘保护着沿海平原，附近设有盐场。明清数百年间，地方屡次修筑加固海塘，以应对不断变化的海岸环境。

english:
Cizre, known in Arabic as Jazirat Ibn Umar, stands where the Tigris leaves its mountain gorges for the plains of the Jazira. A canal across a bend in the river once made the town an island, giving it its name and creating a natural defence around the settlement. The bridge and river port connected routes from Amid, Nisibis and Iran, while rafts could travel downstream towards Mosul. The great mosque and the remains of the medieval bridge recall the prosperity of this fortified crossing.

By the fourteenth century Cizre had become the seat of the Kurdish emirs of Botan. In 1384–85 the ruler of Hasankeyf attempted to seize it, but the emir of Botan repelled him and consolidated his position. The emirate later acknowledged Safavid authority; after the Ottoman victory at Chaldiran in 1514, Idris Bitlisi persuaded its ruler to accept Ottoman suzerainty. Botan's hereditary rulers continued to govern from Cizre under the empire.

The town also became a centre of Kurdish literary tradition. The love story of Mem and Zin, associated with the court of Cizre, was celebrated in the poem composed by Ahmad Khani in 1694 in the northern Kurmanji dialect of Kurdish. Between the river, fortress and mountain of Judi, Cizre retained its place as both a political seat and a setting for stories cherished throughout the Kurdish lands.
simp_chinese:
吉兹雷在阿拉伯语中称为伊本·欧麦尔之岛，位于底格里斯河流出山间峡谷、进入杰济拉平原的地方。一条横穿河湾的运河曾使城镇成为岛屿，地名由此而来。桥梁和河港连接阿米德、尼西比斯与伊朗方向的道路，木筏可顺流前往摩苏尔。大清真寺和中世纪桥梁遗迹使人想起这座设防渡口昔日的繁荣。

到十四世纪，吉兹雷已成为库尔德博坦埃米尔的驻地。一三八四至一三八五年，哈桑凯伊夫的统治者试图夺取此城，但博坦埃米尔击退进攻并巩固了自己的地位。埃米尔国后来承认萨法维宗主权；一五一四年奥斯曼人在恰尔迪兰获胜后，伊德里斯·比特利西说服当地统治者归附奥斯曼。博坦的世袭领主此后继续在帝国治下以吉兹雷为驻地。

这座城镇也是库尔德文学传统的中心。与吉兹雷宫廷有关的梅姆与津的爱情故事，在艾哈迈德·哈尼一六九四年以库尔曼吉库尔德语写成的长诗中得到传颂。河流、堡垒和朱迪山之间的吉兹雷，既是政治权力的驻地，也是库尔德地区广为珍爱的故事发生之所。

english:
Ckara Ama lies in the Tarapacá country of the Atacama, among dry hills and high plateaus where water is rare and routes follow springs and quebradas. Indigenous communities cultivated small fields, herded llamas and alpacas and fished along the Pacific coast. Caravans connected the high Andes with coastal settlements, moving wool, salt, fish and produce between ecological zones.

The wider Tarapacá region formed part of Inca routes and local señoríos before Diego de Almagro entered it in 1536. Spanish rule placed the district within the Viceroyalty of Peru and reorganized settlement around churches, encomiendas and mining. The town of San Lorenzo de Tarapacá was established in 1717, becoming the administrative and religious center of a scattered highland population.

Silver and other ores drew labor and trade into the province, while mule trains carried supplies across the desert. Ckara Ama itself remained a small settlement within this network, dependent on wells, pasture and roads rather than a dense agricultural plain. Its identity belongs to the Indigenous caravan world and the colonial mining economy of the Atacama. Mountain springs made camps possible.
simp_chinese:
奇卡拉阿马位于阿塔卡马的塔拉帕卡地区，处在干旱丘陵与高原之间，水源稀少，道路沿泉眼和干河谷延伸。原住民社群耕种小块田地，饲养美洲驼与羊驼，并在太平洋沿岸捕鱼。商队把安第斯高地同沿海聚落连接起来，在生态带间运送羊毛、盐、鱼和农产品。

一五三六年迭戈·德阿尔马格罗进入以前，更广阔的塔拉帕卡已属于印加道路与地方领主体系。西班牙统治把地区纳入秘鲁总督区，并围绕教堂、监护征赋制和矿业重组聚落。一七一七年建立圣洛伦索—德塔拉帕卡，成为分散高地人口的行政和宗教中心。

白银等矿石把劳动与贸易带入行省，骡队穿越沙漠运送补给。奇卡拉阿马自身仍是网络中的小聚落，依靠水井、牧场和道路，而非密集农业平原。其身份属于阿塔卡马的原住民商队世界与殖民矿业经济。山泉使商队与季节营地在荒地中能够停留。泉水维系聚落。

english: Clackmannan stands above the valley of the Forth, under the watch of a tall stone tower on King's Seat Hill. In 1359 David II granted the lands to his kinsman Sir Robert Bruce, and the tower became the seat of the Bruces of Clackmannan. The family enlarged its residence over the centuries and in the 1650s began exploiting coal seams in the district. The tower remained a conspicuous landmark above the town and river.
simp_chinese: 克拉克曼南位于福斯河谷上方，国王座山上的高大石塔俯瞰着小镇。1359年，戴维二世将土地授予亲族罗伯特·布鲁斯爵士，塔楼成为克拉克曼南布鲁斯家族的驻地。数百年间，家族扩建住所，并在十七世纪五十年代开始开采当地煤层。塔楼始终是城镇和河流上方醒目的地标。

english: Clarence Island lies south of the Strait of Magellan in the western Fuegian archipelago. Its wet, cold landscape includes evergreen Magellanic forest, with coigüe and canelo, as well as extensive peatlands. Channels divide this mountainous island from its neighbours, and the heavily indented coast forms part of the maritime world through which Kawésqar canoeists travelled.
simp_chinese: 克拉伦斯岛位于麦哲伦海峡以南的火地群岛西部。岛上寒冷潮湿的景观包括麦哲伦常绿林，生长着南青冈和卡内洛树，也有大片泥炭地。水道将这座多山岛屿与邻岛分开，曲折的海岸属于卡维斯卡尔人乘独木舟往来的海上世界。

english: Northeast of St Lawrence Island, these Bering Sea waters lead towards Norton Sound and the Seward Peninsula. The island's eastern end is a landmark for vessels approaching the sound. Farther north, Port Clarence offered shelter near Bering Strait; in 1827 Frederick William Beechey described the harbour during the voyage of HMS Blossom, sent to meet John Franklin's Arctic expedition.
simp_chinese: 圣劳伦斯岛东北方的这片白令海水域通向诺顿湾和苏厄德半岛。驶往诺顿湾的船只可将岛屿东端作为航行标志。更北方的克拉伦斯港是白令海峡附近的避风处；1827年，弗雷德里克·威廉·比奇在“花神”号航行期间记述了这座港湾。该船奉命前去会合约翰·富兰克林的北极探险队。

english: Point Clark projects from the eastern shore of Lake Huron, where a sandy point lies beneath a wooded bluff. Across the lake to the northwest is Thunder Bay, near Alpena; a submerged ridge stretches between the two shores. The waters off the point form part of the wide southern basin of Huron, an inland sea whose opposite shore lies far beyond the horizon. To the south the lake narrows towards the St Clair River and the passage to Lake Erie.
simp_chinese: 克拉克角伸入休伦湖东岸，沙质岬角后方是一片林木覆盖的高岸。隔湖向西北望去是阿尔皮纳附近的桑德湾，一道水下山脊横跨湖底，连接两岸。岬角外的水域属于休伦湖宽阔的南部盆地，湖面如内海一般，对岸远在视野之外。往南，湖面逐渐收窄，通向圣克莱尔河和前往伊利湖的水道。

english: Clermont stands on a hill above the Limagne plain, beneath the volcanic peaks of Auvergne. Its cathedral and bishop's city faced the neighbouring town of Montferrand, a separate community with its own institutions. In 1630 the Edict of Troyes ordered the two towns united under Louis XIII. Resistance to the arrangement endured, and a second royal edict in 1731 confirmed the union that gave Clermont-Ferrand its double name.
simp_chinese: 克莱蒙坐落在俯瞰利马涅平原的山丘上，背后是奥弗涅的火山群峰。这座主教城及其大教堂与邻近的蒙费朗相望；后者原是拥有自身制度的独立城镇。1630年，路易十三颁布《特鲁瓦敕令》，强令两城合并。当地对这一安排的抵触持续多年，直到1731年第二道王室敕令再次确认合并，形成克莱蒙费朗的双重名称。

english:
Clermont-en-Argonne stood on a fortified height in the wooded Argonne, where the counts of Bar built a castle and keep. The stronghold passed with their lands to the dukes of Lorraine, but French kings also asserted claims to it. Its defences guarded a district repeatedly exposed to armies crossing the frontier.

In 1632 Duke Charles IV of Lorraine ceded Clermont to Louis XIII, an arrangement confirmed in 1641. The Clermontois was granted to the Prince of Condé in 1648, but he later rebelled during the Fronde. Royal forces besieged Clermont in 1654, facing a small garrison short of food and water; after its surrender Mazarin ordered the fortifications demolished. The siege left much of the town damaged and many inhabitants forced to leave their homes.
simp_chinese:
阿尔贡的克莱蒙位于森林地区的一处设防高地，巴尔伯爵在此修建城堡和主塔。要塞随其领地转入洛林公爵之手，但法国国王也声称拥有此地。防御工事守护的地区屡遭越过边境的军队侵扰。

1632年，洛林公爵查理四世将克莱蒙让给路易十三，这一安排于1641年得到确认。1648年，克莱蒙地区赐给孔代亲王，但他后来在投石党运动中反叛。王军于1654年围攻克莱蒙，面对缺乏粮水的小规模守军；投降后，马扎然下令拆除防御工事。围城使城镇大部分受损，许多居民离开家园。

english:
Clermont-en-Beauvaisis grew beneath the castle of its counts on a height above the surrounding plain. Its keep and the walls of the town made it a visible centre of local authority. The country around Clermont was also one of the scenes of the Jacquerie, the great French rural rising of 1358.

The revolt ended in a confrontation between the rebels and the nobles near Clermont. Tradition holds that its leader Guillaume Cale was executed in the town’s main square. The following year Clermont’s castle was besieged by Jean de Grailly, the Captal de Buch, who served the English crown. Louis II of Bourbon later restored the damaged castle, and work from around 1370 strengthened its enclosure and the defences of the town.
simp_chinese:
博韦地区的克莱蒙发展于伯爵城堡之下，城堡位于俯瞰周围平原的高地。主塔和城墙使这里成为地方权力中心。克莱蒙周边也是1358年大规模乡村起义「扎克雷」的发生地之一。

起义以农民和贵族在克莱蒙附近交锋而告终。传统认为，其领袖纪尧姆·卡勒在镇上的大广场被处决。次年，效忠英格兰王室的比什领主让·德·格拉伊围攻城堡。波旁的路易二世后来修复受损城堡，约从1370年起的工程加强了城堡围墙和城镇防御。

english:
Cles stands in the Trentino Alps as the principal town of Val di Non. Monte di Cles and Monte Peller rise to the west, the latter reaching 2,319 metres, while the Noce valley opens eastward.

Water has long defined the valley by shaping routes, farming land and settlement across the mountain floor. An inscription from Cles records Emperor Claudius’s edict of AD 46 granting Roman citizenship to the Anauni, Sinduni and Tulliasses.

The inscription shows how Alpine communities were absorbed into Roman law and political organization, and it also preserves finds about fiscal disputes. Church buildings, castles and the surrounding wooded slopes mark a long-settled corridor between high mountains, where control of the valley and its water supplies remained essential.
simp_chinese:
克莱斯位于特伦蒂诺阿尔卑斯山区，是农谷的主要城镇。蒙特·迪·克莱斯与佩勒山位于西面，后者海拔2319米，诺切河谷向东展开。

水长期通过限定道路、耕地和聚落来塑造谷地生活。一块出自克莱斯的铭文记载了克劳狄皇帝于公元46年颁布的敕令，把罗马公民权授予阿瑙尼人、辛杜尼人和图利亚塞斯人。

铭文显示阿尔卑斯社群如何进入罗马法律和政治组织，也保存了财政争讼的线索。教堂、城堡和周围林木覆盖的山坡，标示出一条由高山夹峙、长期有人定居的谷地走廊；控制通道与水源始终是这里的关键。

english: Clew Bay opens onto the Atlantic on the coast of Mayo, its inner waters scattered with small islands beneath the slopes of Croagh Patrick.
